tei:div.tei:p: (1na)chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ bka' tshoms dang phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan/ lam mchog rin chen phreng ba/ chos bzhi mdor bsdus/ nyams len mdor bsdus gnad kyi gzer gsang*/ zhal gdams gsang mdzod ma/ ḍoṃ bhi pa'i gtum mo/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gtum mo/ bar do'i gdams pa/ 'pho ba'i zhal gdams bcas bzhugs//

"$ (1ba)༄༅// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// gyad nor bu de phyi rol la sogs pa nas mi btsal te/ de rang gi lus kyi nang na yod pas chog kyi nor bu lto na yod// zla ba'i ngo bo bla ma'i rtogs pa 'gyur ba med pa yin pa ltar rtogs pa'i/ 'phel 'grib med// 'ja' tshon ltar chos la zab mi zab yod/ ri mo so sor gsal// byis pa rnams la lo bskyed dgos/ ltar rnal 'byor pa la yang*/ skad cig gcig la go dgos/ /khang bla ma rtogs ldan cig gis rtogs pa'i rim pa'am/ pa nang gi mi de yis// phyi rol chos kyi gnad che chung rnams/ skye ba'i rim pa gang*// mi de nyid kyi bla ma mkhas pa rtogs ldan/ shes pa las// mthong gis gzhan bla ma mi mkhas pas/ gyis ga la shes// mi de nyid la dri bar bya/ rtogs ldan gyi bla ma bzang po ste bla ma mkhas pa gces/ /dang po sems ni dran pa gces/ gzhan don du byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ /skyon gyis ma gos sna tshogs padma'i steng du/ stong pa la// thabs zla ba'i (2na)dkyil 'khor dkar po/ dang shes rab nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar po/ gdan la yang*// nga dang nga yab he ru ka ru bsgom par yum rnal 'byor ma/ bya// dbang phyug de yi g.yas nas su// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ yig thugs// skar mda' de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de yi 'od kyis ni// khang pa bdag po phyi snod gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can lha'i rnam pa/ bcas nas kyang*// bsnyen bkur phyi nang gsang gsum gyi mchod pas mchod/ thams cad de la dbul// de nas de dag yang 'od zer 'phros pas lha tshogs de dag kyang*/ thams cad kyang*// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rtsa ba'i bla ma 'ba' zhig tu gyur/ rgyal po la// de nyid de phyi nang gsang gsum/ gsum gyis mchod byas la// dgos 'dod pa'i don ci yod gsol ba gdab/ pa gang dang gang yang 'ong phar tshur/

yin zhu// spros dang rang la thim/ bsdus pa'i sbyor ba yis// 'khor bla ma ni bdag nyid/ los sgyur rgyal bdag nyid bsgom// lhug pa'i (2ba)ngang la bzhag de nas ma bcos pa'i ngang la/ par bya// rgyal gnyis dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma/ rdo rje can gyi sku// de yi gsungs pa rdo rje'i bla ma'i gsung gdams ngag zab mo/ tshig /gting mtha' med pa rgya mtsho la/ rgyal ba'i bka' mdo rgyud zab mo/ de'i zab pa'i mtha' la thug pa med/ /ting 'dzin skyo sangs skabs kyis bsgom pa gal che/ rtsa ba lta rtogs/ su bya// de dang de yi rang mi/ 'dod chags sam zhe sdang*/ bzhin la// bdag nyid kyi zhe sdang*/ chen po nga rgyal bskyed// de la lnga ldan gnad phyag rgya chen po/ du bsnun// de nyid 'dod chags sam zhe sdang gang yin pa/ de yi gdul byar 'gyur// gti mug sna la zhe sdang rgyob// lnga ldan nyon mongs pa gang dang gang skyes pa de la phyag rgya chen po/ ral gri'i 'khor lo bskor// rabs chad skye ba med pa'i don la/ bu yi smyon pa la/ 'gag pa med pa'i rtsal/ /lcags sna gnyis thabs shes rab/ kyi ral gri bskur// nga dang bu ru nyon mongs pa rags pa dang phra ba/ bcas pa la// nye nyon mongs pa bag la nyal ba dang*/ 'brel rtsa lag ma lus pa/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon dang bcas pa/ /thams cad thabs shes rab gnyis kyis/ de yis bde ba mthong*/ nyon mongs pa'i/ /ma lus ro gnyis med tsam du 'dzin pa phra mo/ de me la bsregs// thal gnyis med kyi ngang la phyams kyis btang la/ de'i ngang la ma yengs bar bya/ ba chu bo'i gzhung la bskur// 'og min nam spyi gtsug bde chen gyi 'khor lo/ mkha'i pho brang nas// chu 'dzin zla haṃ yig byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin la/ ba'i dkyil 'khor la// gnyis med byang sems skya na ra ra bab ste/ 'o ma'i rgyun babs te// yur po che rtsa dbu ma'i nang na mar/ la bcug nas kyang*// zhing

lus kyi rtsa phran thams cad dang*/ sogs rdzing bzhi rtsa chen 'khor lo bzhi/ khengs par bya// dkar tshoms (3na)kyi le'u 'o// ༈ // phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan ni/ sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam pa yi// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir phyag rgya chen po'i man ngag la rnam pa lnga ste/ rtogs pa lta ba dang ldan pa/ sgom pa nyams myong dang ldan pa/ spyod pa ro snyoms dang ldan pa/ gdams ngag brgyud pa dang ldan pa/ nges shes skyon bsal ba dang ldan pa'o// rtogs pa ni/ rnam pa gnyis te/ de la rgyas par bshad pa ni/ tha snyad rnam par bzhag pa'i dbang du byas na/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad/ zhi lu dang*/ yungs kar gnyis mar gyi rgyu yin par gcig pa bzhin du/ 'khor ba dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin gnyug ma'i sems su gcig ste/ rang sems bla mar shes pa'i dus su/ sems can dang sangs rgyas rgyu gcig par shes par bya'o// sems can dang sangs rgyas rgyu gcig tu rtogs par bya ba ltar/ snang ba dang sems snang ba bla mar shes pa'i dus su/ snang tshad phyag rgya chen por shes par bya'o// tha mi dad du rtogs par bya'o// de yang sangs rgyas dang*/ sems can gnyis/ dper na til dang til mar dang*/ chu dang chab rom snang ba dang stong pa gnyis/ bzhin du shes par bya'o// lta ba ni/ gang la 'khor 'das kyi dngos po gang la yang*/ yang zhen pa med pa ste/ sangs rgyas thob gnyug ma las/ logs su sangs rgyas cig ma mthong bas so// tu mi re/ dmyal bar song gis/ gnyug ma las gzhan pa'i rgyu'i 'khor ba ma mthong ba'o/ mi dogs pa'o// sgom pa ni/ ngos dang po sgom pa ni rang rig 'od gsal gyi man ngag bzung med cing phyogs su ma lhung ba gnyis pa rtag chad la sogs pa'i/ ste/ tha snyad gang gis kyang brjod brjod pa'i sgra dang*/ par (3ba)mi nus pa'o/ rtogs pa'i 'di yin zhes/ de yang shes snang ba dkar dmar la sogs pa'i yul la dmigs te/ pa phyir mi bzhag /nang

ting nge 'dzin gyi mtshan ma gang la yang*/ du mi 'gugs/ rang lugs 'gag med du ngos bzung med pa wal le/ lhug pa gtad med du bzhag /nyams su myong ba ni/ rgyun chad gnyid dang rmugs pa la sogs pa med par/ med pa ste/ 'gro 'chag nyal 'di yin bya ba'i/ 'dug thams cad du bsgom du med kyang*/ yengs ba de la mtshan 'dzin/ skad cig kyang mi bya'o// shes pa mar me rlung gis mi bskyod pa lta bu/ me re ba dang*/ ldem rgya mtsho lta bu/ pa dang*/ phyang ngos bzung med pa/ po dang*/ bde ba bde ba khyad par du byas pa'i ngos bzung*/ gsal ba dang*/ snang ba la phyi rol gyi yul dkar dmar la sogs pa/ rab rib tu 'dug pa dang*/ gza' gtad chung ba dang*/ brjed mtshan ma'i tha snyad thams cad/ ngas pa dang*/ dgod snying gsal zhing bde ba/ 'dod pa dang*/ ngu snying snying mi dga' bas/ 'dod pa dang*/ rgyug pa dang*/ 'jig tha mal ba'i/ rten pa'i spyod lam gzhan dang mi mthun pa byung na/ nyams myong gi rtags yin te/ gang la yang zhen chags dang*/ ngo mtshar du mi rtsi/ shes 'thom/ pa bying rmugs dang*/ zang zing du 'dug pa dang*/ 'gyod pa dang*/ shes pa nam mkha' ma dag pa lta bu byung na/ rlung tshigs la zhugs te 'thums pa yin pas/ tshogs drug lhug gnyid la sogs pa mi 'gog par bzhag la/ shes pa rang dgar yul la rang yan du/ btang ngo*// des kyang btang bas kyang 'thibs pa la sogs pa'i/ skyon ma spangs na/ snang ba thams cad la sems rtsal sbyong du gzhug go /de la sogs pa'i nyams myong ci byung yang*/ skyon du mi lta'o// spyod pa ni/ gang la man ngag (4na)gsum pa grub mtha' la sogs pa'i dgag sgrub/ yang phyogs su ma lhung ba'o// ro snyoms ni/ 'jig rten pa las go log la 'jig rten pa pa'i spyod pa dang*/ dang tshul mi mthun par bya'o// man ngag ni/ rang sems sangs rgyas su shes kyang bla ma rje btsun rnams mi spang*/ snang ba sems su rtogs kyang*/ 'dus kun rdzob/ byas kyi dge rtsa rgyun mi bcad/

dmyal bar song gi dogs pa med kyang*/ sdig pa la 'dzem/ sangs rgyas la re ba med kyang*/ chos gang la yang phyi nang gi bskur ba mi btab/ rang la ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan mchog dang thun mong gi ci lta bu byung yang nga rgyal mi bya/ 'khor 'das gnyis med du rtogs kyang*/ dgon pa bsten pa la goms par bya/ rang gzhan tha mi dad du rtogs kyang*/ sems can la snying rje chen po rgyun chad na thon du mi 'gyur/ mi bcad/ brgyud pa ni/ sangs brgyud pa dang mi ldan na byin rlabs mi 'byung bas/ rdo rje 'chang nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad la/ dam nyams dang bslab 'chal gyis bar ma chod pa'o// rgyas nas/ da lta yan chad kyi bla ma rje btsun pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes gsol ba btab cing maṇḍal dus thams cad du sgo gsum gus pa'i sgo nas lus dang longs spyod dus gsum dge rtsa/ dbul/ nges pa'i shes pa ni lnga ste/ rang gdod ma nas sangs rgyas yin par sems kyang rang bzhin/ nges shes bskyed/ gza' gtad med pa'i don ma rtogs na/ 'khor ba sdug bsngal bar nges shes bskyed do// lhan cig lus ngag yid gsum smin cing grol bar bya/ skyes pa'i ye shes gnyug mar nges shes bskyed/ rtogs pa'i ngang la sems bzhag na 'bras bu thams cad rang chas su 'char (4ba)bar nges shes bskyed do// 'khor dang po rgyu ma rnyed/ bar du rang gi ngo bo ma rnyed/ tha ma rang gi 'bras bu ma rnyed pa de thar pa'o// ba thog ma dang tha ma med par nges shes bskyed/ skyon bsal ba ni brgyad de/ re dwogs gnyis byung na/ lta ba ma rtogs pa'i skyon/ bsgom bya sgom byed gnyis byung na sems rtse gcig med pa'i skyon/ blang dor gnyis byung na/ bsgom par ma byas pa'i skyon/ yo byad dang nye du la chags na/ lam du 'khyer ma shes pa'i skyon/ phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan zhes bya'o// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung sgros/

lam mchog rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// gol sa thams cad gcod mdzad la// yang dag don ni ston mdzad cing*// chos nyid ngang du rtogs pa yi// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu'i rkyen/ bdag po'i rkyen/ dmigs pa'i rkyen/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen te bzhi'o// log pa'i bshes gnyen 'khrul pa dang re dwogs la zhen pa/ yang dag pa'i bshes gnyen ma 'khrul ba/ re dwogs med pa/ gsol 'debs nus pa/ 'gal sgyur nus pa/ go 'byed nus pa'o// shes pa'i mtshan nyid/ khyad par gyi mtshan nyid/ byed pa'i mtshan nyid/ ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid do// shes pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ shes rab kyis sems kyi mtshan nyid ngo shes par bya ste/ skye ba med pa chos sku/ 'gag pa med pa longs sku/ gnas pa med pa sprul sku/ sku gsum brtags pa'i blo la snang ba/ tshig tu brjod 'dod kyang*/ ngo bo la ngos bzung dang bral ba blo'i yul las 'das pa ngo bo nyid kyi sku/ sems kyi mtshan nyid sku bzhir shes par bya'o// khyad par gyi mtshan nyid ni/ rnam rtog gang byung (5na)sems nyid yin pas/ mi spong bar sku bzhir 'khyer ba'o// byed pa'i mtshan nyid ni/ rtog pa sku bzhi yin yang byed pa po med/ chos nyid kyi sgyu ma lta bur 'gro /ngo bo nyid kyi mtshan nyid ni/ gdod ma nas sku bzhir lhun gyis grub pa yin/ de ltar chos thams cad mtshan nyid bzhi las ma 'das par shes tsa na/ lta ba'i go cha ste/ thams cad shes rab kyi yul du shes nas mtha' khegs te/ dper na bya thag pas btags pa dang 'dra'o// shes rab kyi go cha ni/ rkang pa rdo rje skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag /lus bsrang*/ mig sna rtser phab la/ shes rab kyis sems kyi mtshan nyid bltas la/ tshig tu lan gsum brjod pa ni thos pa'i shes rab bo// tshig la brten nas don go ba ni/ bsam pa'i shes rab bo// rtog pa don du shes pa ni sgom pa'i shes rab bo// shes rab kyis de ltar lag tu lon nas/

rtogs pa mngon du gyur ba'i sangs rgyas zhes de la bya'o// skyabs su 'gro ba'i dbang du byas na/ de lta bu'i don rtogs shing khong du chud na/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su song ba yin/ chos thams cad de nyid yin pas/ rtogs pa lam du byed na/ chos la skyabs su song ba yin/ de ltar rtogs pa lam du byed pa'i mkhan po rten med pa'i rig pa las byung bas/ thogs pa med pa'i shes rab dge 'dun la skyabs su song ba yin/ de lta bu'i khyad par can gyi lam de la rtogs pa ci skyes thams cad pha rol du phyin pa'i lam du 'gro/ thabs su 'gro /rtog pa nyid kyis bskul ma btab nas grogs su 'gro ste/ rtog pa gang gi mtshan nyid shes pa ni shes rab/ rtog pa thams cad lam du byung (5ba)bas bsam gtan/ rtog pa skyes tshad lam nyid du skyes pas/ yongs su sbyong ba'i brtson 'grus/ chos nyid zab mo'i don la mi skrag pas bzod pa/ de lta bu'i bsam gtan de la/ nyon mongs pa'i sa bon med pas/ zag pa med pa'i tshul khrims/ de lta bu'i thabs shes kyi rten 'brel lag tu blangs pas/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i sems can la snying rje ngam ngam shugs kyis skyes nas/ ci byed sems can gyi don du 'gro bas sbyin pa'o// de lta bu dang ldan pa'i lam 'di la skabs brgyad/ de ltar sgrub pa po'i lag char khyer bas phyir mi ldog pa thob ste/ sems dang rtog pa tha mi dad cing sku bzhir khyer bas/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad lam du shes pas/ lam shes/ sgrub pa po thabs la mkhas nas byas pa ma yin te/ gdod ma nas rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid de ltar yin par shes pas/ gzhi shes/ rgyu lam 'bras bu ngo bo gcig tu sbyong bas/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs/ de ltar shes pas shes rab rno// shes rab kyi rtsal sbyong ba la tshegs med pas/ rtse mo/ de ltar rtog pa mi spong bar mthar gyis sgrub pas/ mthar gyis pa/ shes rab kyi gnas skabs su chos thams cad kyi mnyam pa nyid shes pas/

skad cig ma la byang chub pa/ thams cad chos kyi sku'i 'phrin las su longs spyod pas/ sku yongs su rdzogs so// khyad par gyi lam 'di la/ lam rnam pa lnga'i dbang du byas nas/ rtog pa dge sbyor gyi grogs su 'gro bas tshogs lam/ rtog pa nyid la brten nas lam khyad par can skye bas sbyor lam/ rtog pa nyid sku bzhir myong bas mthong lam/ rtog pa gang skyes kyang sku bzhi dang mi 'bral (6na)bas sgom lam/ de nyid la nges shes skyes na/ de las phul du phyin pa'i lam gzhan bslab rgyu med pas/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo// lam de nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun du 'gro ste/ dran pa byung tshad lam du 'gro bas/ dran pa nyer gzhag /rtog pa mi spong bar/ shes rab kyis rtogs pa'i mtshan nyid shes pa de nyid/ yang dag par spong ba lam de la rdzu 'phrul thams cad 'byung bas rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi/ dad pas rgyu byas/ dran pas lam byas/ brtson 'grus kyis grogs byas/ de gsum ni thabs yin te/ de gsum de ltar shes pas shes rab/ thabs shes kyi rten 'brel skrun pas/ thams cad ting nge 'dzin du byung bas 'bras bu/ de ltar dbang po lnga lag tu blangs pas shes rab kyi rtsal dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'byongs pa la tshegs med pas/ stobs lnga/ de ltar thabs shes kyi rten 'brel bskul bas shes rab kyi rtsal 'byongs/ de la byang chub kyi sems skyes pas/ dran rig thams cad byang chub kyi grogs su 'gro bas/ byang chub kyi yan lag go /thams cad byang chub kyi yan lag tu shes pas/ rnam rtog la longs spyod kyang*/ rnam rtog gis mi gos par de nyid lam du 'gro bas/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o// de ltar lta ba'i go chas chos kyi brdar sha bcad nas/ gol sa thams cad kyi mtha' khegs nas/ shes rab kyi go chas rtog pa lam du 'khyer ba'i dus su/ gong du bstan pa'i lam la shes rab kyis bsngo bgrang byed dam zhe na/

skyon med de/ lam ni sgom pa'i shes rab 'ba' zhig la byed pa yin la/ sgom pa'i shes rab ni tshig dang (6ba)blo las 'das pa yin/ 'o na lam du ci ltar 'khyer/ gang la brten nas 'khyer na/ rtogs pa la brten nas/ shes rab kyis dran pa la dbang bsgyur cing 'gro/ rtog pa la ci tsug blta na/ rtog pa de nyid blos mi spong bar snying du sdug par blta/ dgos par blta/ sku drin che bar blta'o// de ltar blta ba ci ste zhe na/ yon tan thams cad kho rang la rang chas su yod la/ ngo bo nyid kyi rtog pa yin pas so// de ltar bltas pas rtog pa rang gi mtshan nyid ngo shes nas/ sku bzhi ngo bo nyid kyis 'byung ste/ de ltar rtog pa lam du khyer bas ma zhi nas/ chags sdang gi rtog pa skyes na myur du mi spang bar gong gi lta ba'i go chas gtan la dbab/ de ltar byas pas rtog pa rang zhi rang dag tu 'gro ste/ dper na/ mtsho la 'khyag pa zhu ba'am/ nam mkha' la sprin dengs pa ltar song nas/ yon tan gyis chos su gyur pa thams cad 'gag med du shugs kyis 'byung ste/ yon tan de la zhen nas 'gag nas 'dug na/ de la mi gnas par/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bur shes par byas pa/ gong nas gong du shes rab kyi rtsal sbyang ngo*// de ltar shes rab kyi rtsal gyis rnam rtog sku bzhir thul bas na/ 'dul ba zhes kyang bya/ shes rab kyis rtog pa chos nyid du mthong bas na tshad ma zhes kyang bya/ shes rab kyi rtog pa'i rtsa ba ngo shes te mtha' thams cad dang bral bas/ dbu ma zhes kyang bya'o// gnyug ma ngos 'dzin gyi man ngag yang dag pa gsang bar bya'o// ༈ //

chos bzhi mdor bsdus pa legs so// na mo gu ru/ chos chos su 'gro ba/ chos lam du 'gro ba/ lam 'khrul pa sel ba/ 'khrul pa ye shes su (7na)'char ba cig dgos gsung*/ de yang*/ chos chos su 'gro ba la/ phyi nang gnyis kyi mi rtag pa mang du bsgoms nas/ rdzas/ yo byad/ nye du/ 'brel ba thams cad shul du bzhag nas/ rang gcig pu ga shed 'gro dgos/ de tsa na chos min pa cis kyang mi stongs par 'dug snyam nas/ ci yang byar med kyi blo cig ma skyes par/ chos chos su 'gro ba ye mi 'ong*/ 'chi ba de yang*/ nam 'ong cha med/ sang phod da tsam gyi dbang med/ de bas zla ba phyi ma de tsam gyi dbang yang byar med snyam nas/ 'chi tsa na/ rang rig pa'i ye shes de/ las dge sdig 'ba' zhig dang 'grogs pa yin la/ las ma byas pa dang phrad mi srid/ byas pa chud za mi srid pa yin/ las mi dge bas/ ngan song rnam pa gsum du skyes na/ sdug bsngal ci tsam yod pa/ drag shos lha mi gnyis yin te/ de la yang*/ skye ba/ rgas pa/ 'chi ba/ med pa tshol ba/ yod pa bsrung ba/ dgra sdang ba dang phrad pa/ gnyen byams pa dang bral ba'i sdug bsngal/ lha la yang 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal mnar med pa las bcu drug 'gyur gyis che ba yod/ rigs drug gar skyes kyang*/ sdug bsngal 'ba' zhig tu 'dug snyam nas/ yid 'byung ba tshad du skyel ba cig ma byung gi ring la/ chos chos su 'gro ba mi 'ong*/ chos lam du 'gro ba la/ byams snying rje bdag pas gzhan gces kyi blo/ kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems/ de'i steng du/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rten 'brel tshogs pa'i snang ba/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur go na/ der chos lam du 'gro ba yin/ de ltar go nas lam gyi 'khrul pa sel ba bya ba yin te/ dang (7ba)po mi rtag pa bsgoms pas tshe 'di la zhen pa'i 'khrul pa sel/ las 'bras bsgoms pas/ lta ba ngan pa'i 'khrul pa sel/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsgoms pas/ 'khor ba la chags pa'i 'khrul pa sel/

byams snying rje bsgoms pas/ theg dman gyi 'khrul pa sel/ rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur bsgoms pas/ dngos por 'dzin pa'i 'khrul pa sel/ lar na gong ma gong mas/ 'og ma 'og ma'i 'khrul pa sel gsung*/ de nas 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba bya ba yin te/ don dam par chos thams cad skye 'gag dang bral bar bsgoms pa'i stobs kyis/ cir snang cir rtogs thams cad rang gi ngo bor chod tsa na/ 'khrul pa ye shes su 'char ba yin gsung ngo*// ༈ // nyams len mdor bsdus gnad kyi gzer gsang bzhugs so// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// man ngag blo thor phra mo bsnyad par bya// gting mtha' med pa 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho 'dir// snga ma phan chad ci tsam 'khyams pa'am// da dung ci tsam gcig tu 'khyam dgos pas// gdams ngag thos bsam mang po shes par byos// de las thar pa'i dus ni da res yin// glo bur bar du gcod pa ma byung yang*// tshe la long med yun ring bsdad dbang med// 'jig rten 'di yi bya ba rgyab tu bor// 'di dang phyi ma gnyis ka mi 'grub ste// 'di bas phyi ma gces pas chos la 'bad// gnyid dang snyom las dbang du mi btang bar// stong pa snying rje gnyis la rtse gcig bsgom// tshe la long med 'chi bdag pho nyas 'debs// bya ba thams cad byed 'phro btang nas ni// rang bzhin mnyam pa'i ngang la blo bzhag nas// chos dbyings rnam dag (8na)'di la blta bar bya// mi rtog bde gsal 'di la bsgom par bya// ma bcos rang byung 'di la spyod par bya// sku bzhi ye shes lnga la 'bras bu bya// lta sgom spyod pa 'bras bu bzhi po yang*// so sor tha dad med pa'i lam du bslab// lta ba stong pa yin zhes khas blangs nas// spyod pa dngos por 'dzin las ma grol na// lta spyod gol te log pa'i lam du 'gro /rang gis rang bslus gzhan gyis zhe re khrel// chags sdang skye ba'i grogs ngan thabs kyis spang*// der yang kun dang 'dris par mi bya'o// chags na lha la chags kyang mi grol te// zhen na chos la zhen yang 'ching ba'i rgyu// phyug po gser srang stong la chags pa dang*// dbul po khab skud tsam la chags pa gnyis// lam gyi bar chad byed la khyad par med// des na gang la'ang chags par mi bya'o// 'khrul pa'i rtog pa ma zad bar du ni// dad pas bla ma dang ni dkon mchog mchod// yi dam lha la gsol ba rgyun du gdab// lus ngag dge ba mi dgag nus tshad bya// bsam du med pa'i chos nyid don sgom yang*// 'gro ba rnams la snying rje rgyun du bskyed// stong pa nyid dang snying rje dbyer med par// sgom na gol sa med pa'i lam yin gsung*// da ni le lo'i glags med ring mi sdod// nyin mtshan gnyis kyis tshe 'phrog myur du 'dzad// 'chi khar 'gyod pas mi phan da lta 'bad// dang po ci yang byar med man ngag bsgom/

snang grags thams cad skye med rgya yis gdab// byed spyod thams cad sgyu ma bzhin du spyad// bde sdug thams cad mnyam pa nyid du bslab// ltung ba phra mo tsam la'ang phyir bcos bya// sdom pa gsum dang ldan pa'i rten can gyis// phyag rgya (8ba)chen po'i dngos grub thob par bya// smon lam gdab cing de yi rgyu la 'bad// lus ngag bya ba mang na sems kyang de rjes 'chor// gnyug ma'i sems 'di bcos mas ma bslad cig /sdig dang sdug bsngal 'phel ba'i lam bor nas// mkha' la bya 'phur bzhin du rjes med bya// co 'dri mi sdug zer ba'i lan mi glan// shed mthun rtogs pa bsdur na drang por smra// mdor na chos nyid bsgoms pa'i phyi rtags su// brnyas pa byung yang ko long mi bsdam zhing*// tshig ngan smra na khro bar mi bya la// khyad gsod byung na nga rgyal mi bskyed cing*// 'gal ba ci ltar byung yang 'di ltar bsam// 'khrul pas bcings pa'i sems can snying re rje// skye med chos la nga dang bdag tu bzung*// 'di la dngos po ci yang med do zhes// chos dbyings nyid du nges par bsam par bya// da lta nyid nas de ltar goms byas na// klong du gyur te cis kyang gnod mi 'gyur// rdzas dang yo byad mang po ci yod kyang*// rang dbang yod tshe 'phral bsngo 'phral dag bya// kha cig na re 'chi khar nor dgos zer// 'chi dus byung nas nad kyi thebs pa'i tshe// nad g.yog mang yang sdug bsngal bgo thabs med// des na nad g.yog yod med gnyis ka 'dra// shul na gtam bzang gtam ngan yod mod kyang*// bdag gi rjes phyir 'brangs nas 'ong ba med// gson tshe dge sdig gnyis po gang byas pa// 'bras bu smin pa'i dus su 'byin par gsungs// rnal 'byor pa yi shi lugs rnam pa gsum// smyon pa lta bur shi ba rab yin te// ri dwags lta bu shi ba 'bring yin no// rgyal po lta bur shi ba tha ma ste// 'dod pa chung shing chog shes nga rgyal med// gzhan 'brel bkur dang rang (9na)la ngan shos bya// dman sa bzung la rang yang gzhan dag dang*// rang la nyon mongs mi bsog rtogs pa 'phel// des na ci yang khe grags mi bya'o/// /chos dbyings rnam par dag pa la// byang chub ces ni brjod pa yin// byang chub sems ni rtag tu bsten par bya// de ltar sems pa'i gang zag de// byang chub sems dpa' zhes kyang bya// dang po rkyen ngan dag la byol// brtan pa thob nas rkyen ngan grogs su 'gyur// nyam chung rnams la rkyen ngan gnod pa byed// de bas gcig pur gnas shing 'du 'dzi spangs/

༈ /tshe 'di'i lto rgyab ji ltar byas kyang phyid// byang chub 'bras bu phyi nas btsal thabs med// phyi ma'i dus na chos dang phrad pa'ang dka'// de bas tshe 'dir chos la yang dag 'bad// 'di ru ma byas phyi mar sdug bsngal te// de bas bsod nams myur du bsag par rigs// dal 'byor mi lus phyi nas rnyed par dka'// 'o skol mi rtag myur du 'chi ba la// byed rgyu chos dang bstun la lha ru dkon mchog mchod// bla ma dam pa bsten cing dam pa'i gdams ngag zhus// cig car rtogs par dka' yang rim gyis rtogs te 'ong*// dngos grub myur du thob kyis lam la yid ches gyis// dam pa'i gdams ngag lags kyi sems la bzung zhing sgoms// chos rje dpal ldan bla ma dam pa sgam po pa'i gdams pa/ nyams len bsdus pa'o// maṅga laṃ wantu// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ zhal gdams gsang mdzod ma bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo chen po nā ro pa'i bzhed pas/ skye shi bar do/ rmi lam bar do/ srid (9ba)pa bar do gsum du gnas/ rnam smin lus dang bag chags lus// yid kyi lus dang gsum du gnas// chos rnams thams cad stong pa dang*// gnyid dang 'od gsal dag tu gnas// dbang dang 'dun pa drag po dang*// rang gi pha ma gsum du gnas// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// bar do gsum du bsre ba yin// de ni bar do'i rnam bzhag bca' ba'o// 'bum lnga rgyud sde rgya mtsho lta bu las// bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug brtag gnyis padmo 'khrungs// thugs kyi gsang mdzod gtsug gi rin po che// ge sar mchog la bdud rtsi'i bcud gnas pa// bla ma'i man ngag nyi ma'i 'od kyis phye// nā ro chen po sbrang ma'i rtsi yis 'thung*// zhal gyi gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag pa// skal ldan tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i rgyud brlan nas// byang chub myu gu skye 'dir smin mdzad pa'i// zhe sdang rdo rje'i zhabs la spyis btud nas// zhal gyi gdams ngag rin chen phreng 'dra ba'i// tshig gi srad bur legs brgyus bdag gis bri/// /bla ma grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo chen po nā ro pa 'di yi mi chos kyis yul kha che lags skad/

de yang rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa'i paṇḍi ta cig yin/ de yang*/ bde mchog 'khor lo'i rnal 'byor gyis yi ge bdun pa'i sngags 'bum tsho cig bzlas pas/ sa g.yos shing lung bstan pa byung ste/ khyod rgya gar shar phyogs kyi/ jo bo tai lo pa bya ba'i rigs yin/ jo bo tai lo pa bya ba de/ khyod kyi skye ba bdun gyi bla ma yin pas/ de la gdams ngag zhus la sgoms shig /ces bya ba'i lung bstan byung ste/ jo bo tai lo pa dang*/ nā ro pa gnyis/ o tanta gtsug gi nor bu'i (10na)gtsug lag khang du mjal ba yin gsung*/ jo bo tai lo pa la gdams ngag gi bka' bzhi babs pa yin te/ slob dpon klu sgrub kyi gdams ngag gi bka' gcig babs/ bram ze chen po sa ra ha pa'i gdams ngag gi bka' gcig babs/ slob dpon nag po pa'i gdams ngag gi bka' gcig babs/ mkha' 'gro ma su kha siddhi skal pa bzang mo'i gdams ngag gi bka' gcig babs pa yin gsung*/ jo bo tai lo pa'i phyags phyir/ jo bo nā ro pas lo bcu gnyis bzhugs nas/ lo re la dka' ba mi 'dra ba shi la khad pa bcu gnyis spyod pa'i mthar/ gdams gtum mo a thung gi gdams ngag skye ba med pa'i don/ ngag 'di tsho gnang ba yin gsung*/ jo bo nā ro pa'i spyan sngar/ bla ma mar pas lo bcu gnyis bzhugs te/ gser gyi maṇḍal yang yang phul nas zhus pas/ gdams ngag bi kra ma la shī la'i gtsug lag khang gi byang phyogs su/ 'di tsho gnang ba yin gsung*/ bla ma mar pa la/ bla ma rngog gis spong thag lan gsum byas pa'i mthar gdams ngag 'di gnang ba yin gsung*/ gdams ngag 'di ni sgom nges pa la bstan gyi/ mi sgom pa la ni mi bstan/ zhal gyi gdams pa yin gsung*/ de la jo bo nā ro pa'i bzhed pas bar do rnam gzhag bca' ba dang*/ bar do nyams su len pa gnyis yin gsung*/ bar do rnam bzhag bca' ba la/ bar do rnam pa gsum yin te/ brtag pa phyi ma'i le'u gnyis pa nas/ ji ltar sgyu ma rmi lam dang*// ji ltar bar ma'i srid pa yin// zhes bshad pas/

skye shi bar do/ rmi lam bar do/ srid pa bar do gsum yin gsung*/ skye shi bar do ni/ skyes nas ma shi'i bar de yin/ (10ba)rmi lam bar do ni/ rmi lam zang zing byung nas/ gnyid ma sad kyi bar de yin/ srid pa bar do ni/ shi nas lus ma blangs kyi bar de yin no/// /bar do rnam pa gsum la/ lus rnam pa gsum yin te/ skye shi bar do rnam smin gyi lus/ rmi lam bar do bag chags kyi lus/ srid pa bar do yid kyi lus yin gsung*/ bar do rnam pa gsum la/ sngon 'gro rnam pa gsum yin te/ skye shi bar do la chos thams cad 'od gsal sngon du 'gro dgos/ rmi lam bar do gnyid mthug po sngon du 'gro/ srid pa bar do la 'chi ka'i 'od gsal sngon du 'gro ba yin gsung*/ bar do gsum la mtshams sbyor gsum yin te/ skye shi bar do la dbang gsum pa'i nyams kyis mtshams sbyor ba yin/ rmi lam bar do la 'dun pa drag pos mtshams sbyor/ srid pa bar do la pha ma gnyis kyis mtshams sbyor ba yin gsung*/ bar do rnam pa gsum la bsre ba rnam pa gsum yin te/ skye shi bar do la 'dod chags shas che bas/ 'dod chags dang bsam gtan bsre ba yin/ rmi lam bar do la gti mug shas che bas/ gti mug dang bsam gtan bsre ba yin/ srid pa bar do la zhe sdang shas che bas/ zhe sdang dang bsam gtan bsre ba yin gsung*/ de ltar na bar do gsum/ de la lus gsum/ de la sngon 'gro gsum/ de la mtshams sbyor gsum/ de la bsre ba gsum ste chos bco lnga byas nas/ bar do rnam gzhag bco lnga bshad do/// /bar do rnam pa gsum yin te/ skye shi bar do/ rmi lam bar do/ srid pa bar do dang gsum yin/ bar do rnam pa gsum dang bsre 'pho gnyis kyi man ngag bya gsung*/ bsre ba ni/ bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba'i thabs yin/ 'pho (11na)ba ni/ ma bsgoms pas sangs rgya ba'i thabs yin/ de la dang po bsre ba'i man ngag bya ba ni/ skye shi bar do la bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi man ngag dang bsre/

rmi lam bar do ni/ rmi lam dang bsam gtan bsre ba yin/ skye shi bar do la bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag dang bsre ba la/ sngon du lus dang rlung sbyang ba gal che/ dper na/ zho rkyal legs par ma sbangs par btsan thabs su zho blugs pas/ yang na rkyal pa chud zos/ yang na zho chud zos 'gro ba yin/ zho rkyal sbangs nas zho blugs pas/ zho dang rkyal ba gnyis ka chud mi zos pa yin/ dpe de bzhin du/ rlung ma sbyangs par bsgoms pas/ yang na lus chud zos na tsha 'ong*/ yang na gdams ngag chud zos te nyams myong mi skye bas/ zho rkyal ma sbangs par zho blugs pa dang 'dra ba yin pas/ sngon du lus dang*/ rlung sbyang bar byed pa la/ sgom la nang par 'jug pa'i dgongs mo dkon mchog la mchod pa bya/ chos skyong la gtor ma phul nas/ dge sbyor byed pa la bar chad mi gtong zhig /ces pa la sogs pa'i gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ nang par nas lus dang rlung sgom pa ni/ stan bde ba la/ rkang mthil g.yas pa rkub tshos g.yon la gtad/ rkang mthil g.yon pa rkub tshos g.yas la gtad/ sgal tshigs drang thar gyis bsrang*/ltong mgo yid tsam dgug /lte khung 'og gi sor gnyis kyi sar mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya dam du bsdam/ de nas/ rlung phyir khru gang tsam du btang nas nang du rngubs la/ steng rlung 'og rlung bsdam/ mi thub na sna nas dal bus btang*/ de bzhin du sgom pa'i nyi ma phyed tshun chad thun gnyis/ phye phan chad thun gnyis/ srod la thun (11ba)gcig /tho rangs thun gnyis te/ nyin zhag gnyis la thun drug tu bcad la bsgom/ des mgo dang rkang pa la sogs mi bde/ rlung bsdams la gang mi bde sar sprug gcu/ de bzhin du zhag gsum du bsgom pa ni lus dang rlung sbyang ba'o// de nas/ bskyed rdzogs kyi man ngag bsgom pa la/ gzhi rten bskyed rim gzhung nas bshad pa'i rgyas bsdus bar ma gang mos cig bsgom/ de yang rgyud nas/ ji ltar rigs pa'i rnal 'byor ma bskyed/

ces gsungs pas/ rgyas bsdus bar ma gsum gang mos cig bsgom/ yang na/ bdag dang dngos po thams cad stong pa nyid du phyams kyis bsgom/ de'i ngang la he ru ka gang mos sam/ lha mo bco lnga gang mos pa skad cig gis bsgom/ de ni bskyed rim bsgom pa'o// de nas/ rdzogs rim sgom pa la/ bla mas dpe don gnyis su gsungs te/ dper na/ bod dbus gtsang gnyis po bgrod pa'i lam po che cig yod pa la/ lam de'i g.yas su phag rgod/ g.yon du sbrul/ lam gyi dkyil du glang po che yod na de gsum gyis mi la sogs pa byung na bsad nas bza'/ lam la mi'i rgyu 'grul 'chad/ de gsum yang*/ gcig gi dgra gcig yin pas/ glang po che 'gul na sna bug na sbrul song nas gsod/ sbrul 'gul na/ phag gis gsod/ phag 'gul na glang po ches gsod pas/ de gsum gcig la gcig 'jigs nas 'gul mi nus pa yin/ der khong gsum la za rgyu med pas/ zhag bdun nas ltogs pa'i nad kyis 'chi ba yin/ dpe de bzhin du/ lam po che dang 'dra ba'i sems can gyi rgyud la/ sangs rgyas kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i (12na)ye shes kyi khyab pa yod pa yin/ de ltar yang*/ brtag pa dang po'i le'u dang po nas/ lus la ye shes chen po gnas// lus gnas lus las ma skyes pa'o// zhes gsungs so// de ltar lam gyi g.yas g.yon dbus dang gsum du srog chags gsum yod pas/ mi'i rgyu 'grul chad pa bzhin du/ rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i glang po che dang 'dra ba'i 'dod chags/ sbrul dang 'dra ba'i zhe sdang*/ phag dang 'dra ba'i gti mug gsum gyis/ rang gi rgyud la yod pa'i ye shes skye ba bkag /sems can gsum po ltogs te 'chi ba dang 'dra bar/ bla ma'i gdams ngag zhag bdun bsgoms na/ dug gsum mi rtog par 'char ba yin/ dug gsum mi rtog par 'char ba la/ dus kyi gnad/ lus kyi gnad/ yul gyi gnad gsum yin/ de la dang po dus kyi gnad bya ba/ dhū tir rlung rgyu ba'i dus su sgom/

de yang sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba dang*/ g.yon nas rgyu ba dang*/ gnyis ka nas drag par rgyu ba'i dus su mi sgom/ gnyis ka nas dal bar rgyu ba'i dus su bsgom mo// 'o na gzhan du mi bsgom mam byas pas/ gzhan du'ang bsgom ste/ khyad par du dus der bsgoms pa yin gsung*/ lus bcos pa'i gnad la/ re'u mig ltar bsnol ba/ mda' ltar bsrang ba/ lcags kyu ltar dgug pa/ rgya mdud ltar bsdam pa/ li khri ltar bsgom pa dang lnga yin gsung*/ de nas stan bde ba la 'dug la/ rkang mthil g.yas pa rkub tshos g.yon/ rkang mthil g.yon pa rkub tshos g.yas la gtad la/ gnyis pa sgal tshigs drang thar gyis bsrang*/ gsum (12ba)pa os ko yid tsam 'gug /bzhi pa lte ba nas sor bzhi'i 'og tu mnyam bzhag gis phyag rgya dam du bsdam/ lnga pa li khri'i thag pa de/ ma bsgrims na 'chad/ bsgrims na mi 'chad pa bzhin du/ sems ma bsgrims na nyams myong mi skye bas/ sems shin tu bsgrims gsung ngo*// de la yul gyi gnad la/ lar 'o skol gyi lus 'di la/ 'khor lo bzhi yod pa'i lte ba nas/ a wa dhū ti thal gyis phug nas/ yar sna tshangs pa'i bu ga la gtad/ mar sna lte ba nas sor bzhi'i 'og tu zug pa yin gsung*/ g.yas g.yon gnyis kyi rtsa sna smin mtshams su gtad/ de nas g.yas g.yon du gyes te 'khor lo bzhi la 'byar tsam re byas nas/ gnyer po che na 'khyud nas yod pa yin no// 'o na yul gyi gnad gar sgom na/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo dang*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo dang*/ snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo rnams su mi sgom/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lor yang mi sgom/ lte ba nas sor bzhi'i 'og /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdo der sems gtod pa yin gsung*/ de nas rlung phyir 'gro nang 'gro lan bcu gsum tsam byas la/ rlung phyir khru gang tsam du btang*/ de nas nang du rngubs nas/ g.yas g.yon gyi rtsa gnyis kyi nang na mar song nas/

yar log ste rtsa dbu mar tshud pas/ dper na/ thal bas g.yogs pa'i me la phus btab pas/ me rings kyis 'ong ba bzhin du/ rtsa dbu mar rlung tshud pa tsam gyis rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdo na gtum mo'i me/ mar me'i rtse mo rlung gis ma skyod pa lta bu/ sbom phra rta rnga tsam la ring thung snying kha (13na)chos kyi 'khor lor sleb pa'am/ yang na lte bar sleb pa tsam la sems dmigs pa ni rlung rngub pa'o// de nas steng rlung bsdam pa ni dgang ba'o// dbu mar rlung tshud nas nyams myong skye ba ni gzhil ba'o// rlung ma thub na ba spu'i bu ga thams cad na phar la sib sib song bar bsgom/ des kyang ma thub na/ sna bug g.yas nas dal bus gtang la/ rlung lhag ma en re bzhag /sems kyis tshangs bug na yar la bun bun btang ba ni/ mi thub na 'phang ba'o// de ltar yang nas yang du thun

rlung dang thun la tshad med/ bskyed de bsgom pas/ dang po drod skye/ de nas bde ba skye/ de nas mi rtog pa skye ba yin gsung*/ de yang*/ sgom rem na zla ba gsum na nyams myong skye/ zhan na'ang drug tsam nas mi skye mi srid gsung ngo*// dang po 'di la 'byongs pa gal che/ 'di la zla ba drug bdun bsgoms te nyams myong skyes pa cig gis/ gdod 'od gsal dang gzhan bsgom na tshegs med pa yin te/ sgyu lus la sogs pa bsgom pa'i dus su yang*/ 'di ye mi sgom pa ma yin/ dang po 'di dum re sgom/ de nas sgyu lus la sogs pa gtso cher sgom gsung ngo*// des ni/ skye shi bar dus 'dir lus 'di ltar 'chos la shes pa 'di la gtod la gong ma ni de tsam go ba cig la de ltar bstan pa yin no// dor bskyed rdzogs gnyis dang bsre ba bshad do// de nas rmi lam bar do la/ rmi lam dang bsam gtan bsre ba bya ba de yin/ de la rmi lam gyi 'du shes sngon du btang ba dang*/ gnyid mi 'ong bar bya ba'i thabs dang rmi lam la rmi lam du shes pa dang rmi lam spel ba dang*/ rmi lam sbyang ba dang lnga yin gsung*/ de la rmi lam gyi 'du shes sngon du btang ba (13ba)ni/ chos thams cad rmi lam lta bu yin/ de yang*/ bde ba ci byung thams cad kyang rmi lam lta bu yin te/ kha sang phan chad du 'dod pa'i yod tan lnga la spyod pa dang*/ mdang gi rmi lam du longs spyad pa gnyis/ de ring gi nyi ma la khyad par cung zad kyang mi 'dug /des na/ bde ba ci byung thams cad kyang rmi lam lta bur 'dug /sdug bsngal thams cad kyang rmi lam lta bu yin te/ kha sang phan chad du lus dang sems kyis sdug bsngal mang po ci spyad pa dang*/ mdang rmi lam du spyad pa gnyis/ de ring gi nyi ma la khyad par cung zad kyang mi 'dug /de na/ sdug bsngal ci byung thams cad kyang rmi lam lta bur 'dug /gzhan yang*/ kha sang phan chad du lha'i bdud rtsi ro bcud dang ldan pa cig kham kham zos pa dang*/

mgo ral gris 'gems pa dang*/ lus la mtshon gyis dum bur gtubs pa la sogs pa spyad pa dang*/ mdang rmi lam du spyad pa gnyis de ring gi nyi ma la khyad par cung zad kyang med do// des na chos thams cad rmi lam lta bur 'dug pas/ rmi lam rmi bar bya'o// rmi lam de yang ngo mtshar can/ stod nas me 'bar zhing*/ smad nas chu 'bab pa'am/ nyi zla rkang pas rdzi ba'am/ jo bo nā ro pa dang mjal ba'am/ rang gi yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba la sogs pa rmi bar bya'o// des kyang mi 'ong*/ lag len la 'di gal che bas/ rmi lam rmi ba'i dus su/ rmi lam du shes par bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa yang yang bya'o// gnyid mi 'ong ba 'ong bar bya ba ni/ mgrin par rtsa 'dab ma bzhi pa lte ba dang bcas pa cig bsgom/ de la yi ge bkod nas sems gtad rgyu cig yod de/ lag len la des mi 'ong bas/ smin mtshams su thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ snum (14na)la 'dril ba/ sran rdog tsam cig bsgom/ de las gzhan du mi 'pho tsam du bsgom/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes par bya ba ni/ bag chags kyi dbang gis rmi ste/ de yang*/ de ring ltad mo chen po cig bltas na/ do nub rmi lam du/ rta rgyug /dung 'bud/ dar 'phyar ba la sogs pa rmis pa de bzhin du/ sngar gyi 'dun pa'i stobs kyis rmi lam rmis pa'i dus su/ rmi lam la rmi lam du shes pa 'byung ste/ de yang*/ khyi dang bud med la sogs pa rmi ba'i dus su/ rmi lam gyi khyi dang bud med yin snyam pa 'byung ngo*// rmi lam spel ba ni/ gang rmis pa de la gcig la gnyis la sogs pa log por spel nas/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad mer mer gang bar bsgom mo// rmi lam sbyang ba ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gzhal yas khang*/ nang bcud kyi sems can yi dam lha dang lha mor bsgom/ de'i dus su/ nyams su myong ba skye ba bya ba de/ dang po bla ma'i gsung sgros yin gsung*/ bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/

rang gis sgom pa dang*/ gzhan sgom du bcug pa dang*/ thams cad la mthun par rmi lam gyi 'du shes sngon du btang ba dang*/ gnyid mi 'ong ba 'ong bar bya ba'i thabs byas nas/ rmi lam la rmi lam du ngo shes pa'i dus su/ bde stong gi nyams myong rgyud la skye ba sang nas dga' mo yong*/ yin gsung*/ de ni rmi lam bar do la/ rmi lam dang bsam gtan bsre tshegs mi gda' bas/ nub dang po la ci zin bya gsung*/ ba bshad do// de gnyis ma shi bar gyi bsgom rgyu yin gsung*/ de yang nyal ba'i dus su/ rtsa rlung gi rdzogs rim bsgom/ de gnyis ka la skyon gnyis ka bsgom/ gcig las mi skye na/ gtum mo (14ba)lta bu la skye na/ rmi lam la gtum mo sgom/ rmi lam lta bu la skye na/ gtum mo bzhag nas rmi lam sgom/ de gnyis ka la nyams skye yang rung*/ gang rung cig la skye yang rung ste/ mnyam rjes med par nyams su myong ba skye ba dka'/ mnyam bzhag gi nyams myong zhig med thabs med gsung*/ mnyam bzhag gi de yang dang po sprin dang 'dra ste/ zhes gsungs pas/ sprin bar gyi nyi ma ltar mnyam bzhag yod pas chog nyams myong de srid pa bar dor bsre la/ bar do dang po 'chi ka'i 'od gsal la brten nas/ chos sku ngos bzung ba dang*/ bar do gnyis pa ma dag pa'i sgyu lus la brten nas/ zung 'jug gi sku ngos bzung ba dang*/ bar do gsum pa 'gro drug gi sgo dgag pa gsum yin gsung*/ de la bar do dang po 'chi ka'i 'od gsal la brten nas/ chos sku ngos bzung ba la/ rang 'chi ba'i dus su/ shed kyis nus na tsog pur ma nus na seng ge'i nyal thabs bya/ 'dug /slob ma'am grogs po gcig gis rgyab nas brten la/ nga shi nas nga'i ro 'di/ khyod kyis long yod na zhag gsum/ med na zhag gcig ma sgul cig bsgul na 'od gsal mi zin/ bya/ de nas/ rang gi lte ba'i 'og /rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdo ru/ rtsa padma 'dab bzhi pa dbus kyi lte ba dang bcas pa cig bsam/

lte ba la a gcig bsgom/ mdun du a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon du ra/ gsal bar bsgoms la/ de nas/ 'byung ba sa chu la thim pa'i dus su/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ lus zungs mi thub/ gdong pa la sa gos pa/ rna ba chag pa/ sna zhom pa cig 'byung*/ de'i dus su 'chi ba po rang gi shes pa la/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad sprin gyi rnam par lta bu long long ba (15na)zhig 'byung*/ de yang gur gyi le'u bzhi pa las/ dang po sprin gyi rnam pa ste/ zhes gsung pas/ de'i dus su/ mdun gyi a la shes pa gtad/ de nas chu me la thim pa'i dus su/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ kha chu sna chu/ lan cig phyir lhug pa zhig 'byung*/ de nas/ sangs la skams nas 'gro/ 'chi ba po rang gi shes pa la/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad du ba'i rnam pa lta bu ban bun pa gcig 'byung*/ de yang*/ gnyis pa du ba lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i dus su g.yas kyi nu la shes pa gtad/ de nas me rlung la thim pa'i dus su/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas lus kyi drod shor nas/ rdo bzhin du grang lhang gis 'gro /'chi ba po rang gi shes pa la/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad srin bu me khyer gyi rnam pa lta bu ches mi gsal ba cig 'byung*/ de yang*/ gsum pa srin bu me khyer dngos// zhes gsungs pas/ de'i dus su rgyab kyi ta la shes pa gtad/ de nas rlung rnam par shes pa la thim pa'i dus su/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ dbugs ngar ngar po dang*/ sha sha po 'byung*/ 'chi ba po rang gi shes pa la/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad mar me'i rnam pa lta bu/ bkra lam me gsal ba cig 'byung*/ de yang*/ bzhi pa mar me gsal 'bar ba/ zhes gsungs pas/ de'i dus su g.yon gyi ra la shes pa gtad/ de ltar rnam par shes pa snang ba rags pa phra ba/ phra ba shin tu phra ba la thim pa'i dus su/ nad g.yog pas bltas pas/ lus la g.yo 'gul med/ dbugs 'byung rngub med/ der nad pa shi gda' bya ba las med/

'chi ba po rang gi (15ba)shes pa de cung zhig mi 'phro/ de'i dus su dbus kyi a la shes pa gtad/ sngar gyi bsgoms pa'i nyams myong gi steng du bzhag pas/ de'i dus su sems can thams cad la chos sku ji lta ba zhig shugs kyis skye ba dang*/ sngar gyi nyams gnyis 'dres nas/ de nyid du 'bras bu chos sku thob pa yin/ de ltar yang dag snang ba ni// sprin med nam mkha' lta bu'o// thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu de de// dngos grub nges 'jug nye ba yin// zhes gsungs pas/ bar do rnam pa thams cad du ldang mi srid gsung ngo*// de rnams ni rgyud kyi bshad pa dang bstun pa yin/ lag len la de rnams 'dra bas rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdo ru padma 'dab ma bzhi pa dbus kyi lte ba dang bcas pa gcig bsgom/ dbus kyi lte ba la a gcig bsgom/ mdun du a/ g.yas su nu/ rgyab tu ta/ g.yon du ra gsal bar bsgom/ rtags tsho byung yang rung ma byung yang rung ste/ dang po mdun gyi a la shes pa bzhag /de nas nu/ de nas ta/ de nas ra/ de nas dbus kyi a la shes pa pur gyis bcug nas/ sngar gyi bsgoms pa'i nyams la blo lhan gyis bzhag pas/ de'i dus su sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la 'chi ba chos kyi sku ji lta ba cig rang shugs kyis skye ba dang*/ bsgoms pa'i nyams gnyis 'dres nas/ de nyid du 'bras bu chos sku thob pa yin/ de nas/ bar do rnam pa thams cad du ldang mi srid pa yin gsung*/ des ro 'od dang ldan pa/ kha dog dang ldan pa/ snum zhul le ba cig 'byung ba yin gsung*/ des ni bar do dang po 'chi ka'i 'od gsal la brten nas/ chos sku ngos bzung res gcig gis sangs rgya ba'i thabs/ ba bshad do// de nas/ bar do gnyis pa ma dag pa'i (16na)sgyu lus la brten nas/ zung 'jug gi sku ngos bzung ba la/ bar do dang po 'chi ka'i 'od gsal la brten nas/ chos sku ngos ma zin na/ shi nas bar dor zhag bdun tshan bdun gnas kyang*/

bdun tshan dang po la ma zin na/ de nas zin par dka' bas/ zhag bdun tshan dang po la 'dzin dgos/ bdun tshan dang po la zhag phyed dang bzhi 'das pa'i rjes su dran pa 'byung*/ phyed dang bzhi ma 'ongs pa rjes su dran pa 'byung*/ de yang 'das pa rjes su dran pa zhes pa de/ bdag shi ba yin/ ro 'di yang bdag gi ro yin snyam pa 'byung*/ rang gi slob ma dang*/ grogs po dang*/ spun zla la sogs pa thams cad kyang gsal bar dran pa cig 'byung*/ de'i dus su/ bar do dang po chos kyi sku ngos ma zin par 'dug pas/ bar do gnyis pa zung 'jug gi sku ngos da lta bas stong 'gyur gyis gsal bas longs sku thob/ zin par bya snyam pa yid la bya/ de nas yid kyi lus des/ rang yi dam gyi lha dpal dgyes pa rdo rje bsgom/ rang sems bde stong zab mo sngar gyi bsgoms pa'i nyams la blo lhan gyis bzhag pas/ zhag phyed dang bzhir bskyed rdzogs gnyis bar ma chad par phril phril bsgoms pas/ de nyid du 'bras bu zung 'jug gi sku 'thob pa yin gsung ngo*// des bar do gnyis pa ma dag pa'i sgyu lus la brten nas/ zung 'jug gi sku ngos bzung ba bshad do// de nas bar do gsum pa 'gro drug gi sgo dgag pa la/ zhag phyed dang bzhi 'das pa'i rjes su dran pa'i dus su zung 'jug gi sku ngos ma zin na/ zhag phyed dang bzhi ma 'ongs pa rjes su dran pa'i dus su/ 'gro drug gi sgo dgag dgos pa yin/ de yang*/ ma 'ongs pa rjes su dran pa'i dus su gar (16ba)skye ngo shes pa cig 'ong ste/ lhar skye'am/ mir skye'am/ lha ma yin du skye ba'am/ gar skye ba de'i pha dang*/ ma dang*/ rang re'i rnam pa wal gyis 'char ba zhig 'byung*/ de'i dus su rang gi pha de rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ ma de rdo rje slob dpon gyi yum du bsgom la/ slob dpon yab yum la dbang zhu ba dang*/ gdams ngag gi gsol ba 'debs par bsgoms pas bla ma yab yum la chags sdang skye mi srid pas/

skye ba len mi srid pa yin gsung*/ yang na/ pha ma gnyis dgyes rdor yab yum du bsgoms pas/ yi dam gyi lha yab yum la chags sdang skye ba mi srid gsung*/ des ni bar do gsum pa 'gro drug gi sgo dgag pa bshad do// des ma khegs na/ da lus len pas/ da mngal gyi grong khyer gdams par byed dgos pa yin/ de la rang dbang med par lus len mi srid pas/ lha'am mi'i nang nas kyang chos byed pa cig gi bur skye bar bya'o snyam pa'i 'dun pa btang bas/ sngar bla mas dbang bskur ba dang*/ rang gi bskyed rim bsgom pa'i stobs kyis/ gang 'dod pa'i rigs su skye'o// des ni/ rigs drug gi mngal sgo ma khegs na/ mngal kha bdams pa bshad do// de ltar byas pas/ 'chi kha'i 'od gsal la brten nas chos sku ngos zin pa des/ tshe 'di la sangs rgya ba'i thabs bshad pa yin/ ma dag pa'i sgyu lus la brten nas zung 'jug gi sku ngos bzung ba dang*/ 'gro drug gi sgo dgag pa gnyis kyis bar dor sangs rgya ba'i thabs bshad pa yin/ mngal kha gdams pa des/ skye ba brgyud nas sangs rgya ba'i thabs bshad pa yin/ de ltar na/ bsre ba'i man ngag bya ba de la skye shi bar dor bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyi (17na)man ngag dang bsre/ rmi lam bar do rmi lam dang bsam gtan bsre/ de gnyis ma shi bar du bsgoms rgyu yin/ de gnyis la bsgoms pa'i nyams myong yod pa gcig gis srid pa bar dor bsre ba la bar do dang po 'chi kha'i 'od gsal la brten nas/ chos sku ngos bzung ba dang*/ bar do gnyis pa ma dag pa'i sgyu lus la brten nas/ zung 'jug gi sku ngos bzung ba dang*/ bar do gsum pa 'gro drug gi sgo dgag pa gsum du byas nas/ bsre ba'i man ngag bsgoms nas sangs rgyas pa'i thabs bshad do// da 'pho ba'i man ngag bya ba de yin/ de la bla ma'i zhal nas/ bsgoms na sangs ni kun kyang rgya// ma bsgoms rgya na rgya nges yin// zhes gsungs pas/

ma bsgoms par sangs rgya ba'i thabs/ 'pho ba'i man ngag 'dis sangs mi rgya mi srid gsungs nas/ dbu snyung cig bzhes pa yin gsung*/ gtum mo sgom pa cig gis byed na/ lo gsum mi dgos/ 'di la/ sbyangs te 'pho ba dang*/ btsan thabs su 'pho ba dang*/ lus bcos te 'pho ba gsum yin gsung*/ de la dang po sbyangs te 'pho ba la/ rlung sbyang ba dang*/ 'pho ba sbyang ba dang*/ 'pho ba dngos dang gsum yin gsung*/ rlung sbyang ba ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ rkang mthil g.yas pa rkub tshos g.yon dang rkang mthil g.yon pa rkub tshos g.yas la gtad nas/ sgal tshigs drang thar gyis bsrang*/ tong mgo yid tsam dgug /lte ba nas sor bzhi'i 'og tu phyag mnyam bzhag gi rgya drag tu bsdam/ de nas rlung phyi 'gro nang 'gro lan bcu tsam byas nas/ rlung rnal du phab nas/ phyir khru gang tsam du btang ste nang du rngubs la/ steng 'og gi rlung thub tshad du bsdam/ mi thub na/ sna bug nas dal bus btang*/ gzhan dag (17ba)la 'di dum bur ston/ rlung bum pa can la slob tu gzhug gsung*/ de ltar bslabs pas rlung tshegs med par khegs pa'i tshad la/ slob dpon ngag gi dbang phyug grags pas/ skyil krung byas te lag pa g.yon pas phreng ba bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mthil pus mo la lan gsum bskor nas se gol re la phreng rdog re bgrangs la/ phreng ba du 'dug lta gsung*/ lag len la nges mi 'ong bas/ rang gi slob ma'am/ grogs po cig mdun du bzhag la/ rang nyid ni gong du bstan pa bzhin du lus bcos la rlung bsdams te/ ma thub pa dang se gol gyi brda gcig bya/ grogs po des/ khong rang gi rlung 'byung 'jug gnas gsum la/ gcig tu brtsis pa'i khug pa re la phreng rdog re bgrang*/ se gol gyi brda' byung dus phreng ba 'dren pa 'phro bcad la/ phreng rdog du 'dug bltas pas/ de la rab kyi khug pa brgya rtsa brgyad thub/ 'bring gi bdun cu rtsa gnyis/ tha mas sum cu rtsa drug khegs dgos pa yin te/

'pho ba byed pa la tha ma de khegs pas chog gsung*/ rlung tha ma sum cu rtsa drug ma khegs kyi bar du sbyang ngo*// de nas 'pho ba sbyang ba la zhag bdun sbyangs bas chog pa yin/ de yang gong du bstan pa ltar lus bcos la/ sgo dgu yi ges dgag par bya ste/ spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar kṣ+yum̐/ mig gnyis dang*/ smin mtshams su hūṃ/ rna ba gnyis dang*/ sna bug gnyis su yum̐/ khar sum̐/ lte bar mum̐/ 'og sgo dang*/ rdo rje'i bu gar kṣam̐ bsgoms la/ de nas/ rang gi lte ba'i 'og rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdor/ sems kyi rgyal po yi ge ar gnas pa de/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig drag tu brjod pas/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig gi (18na)thog tu yar drangs/ klad pa'i steng*/ thod pa'i 'og tu yar drang ngo*/ de nas/ rlung phyir 'gro nang 'gro lan gsum tsam byas te ngal bsos nas/ ka hika nyi shu rtsa gcig drag tu brjod pas mar phab la lte bar bzhag /de bzhin du yar 'dren mar dbab cing*/ zhag gcig la thun drug tu byas la bsgom mo/ thun mtshams su lus ngag gi bya ba byed pa'i dus su spyi bor bzhag na/ drag shul lam/ skyig bu'i 'drog la shi nyen yod pas/ mar drangs la lte bar bzhag gsung*/ de ltar bslab pas 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i tshad ni/ sngar las zas mang du yog pa cig 'ong*/ lus la drod che ba cig 'ong*/ dpral ba tsha lam lam pa 'ong*/ spyi bo rdol te 'gro snyam pa yang 'ong*/ rtags de tsho yang 'byung ste/ bla ma'i zhal nas/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig gis yar 'drongs so// ngal bsos nas/ ka hika nyi shu rtsa gcig gis mar 'drangs na 'pho ba 'byongs pa'i tshad yin gsung*/ de yang bla ma'i zhal nas/ lo nyi shu tsam la 'pho ba sbyangs nas/ de nas bzhag ste lo bzhi bcu tsam la 'pho bar 'dod na 'phos pas chog pa yin gsung*/ de ni 'pho ba sbyang ba'o// 'chi rtags byung na 'chi slu bya/ des kyang ma bslus nas 'chi nges pa'i nad kyis thebs nas 'pho ba la/

gdan bzhi rtsa rgyud las/ 'chi 'pho'i mtshan ma mthong ba yis// 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i dus byung na// rims la sogs pa ma phog par// 'pho ba sbyor ba mchog yin no// zhes gsungs pas na/ rang yi dam lha'i thang sku mdun du bkram la/ sems kyis yi dam lha dang bla ma spyan drangs la/ gong du bstan pa ltar lus bcos la/ sgo dgu yi ge dgus (18ba)dgag /lte ba nas sor bzhi'i 'og rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdo na/ sems kyi rgyal po yi ge ar gnas pa de/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig gis yar drangs/ ka hig nyi shu rtsa gcig gis mar drangs te nyams sad pa yin/ de nas/ rkang mthil gnyis/ dku g.yas g.yon gnyis/ mchan khung gnyis rnams su/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor drug tu bsgom/ snying padma 'dab bzhi'i phyogs bzhir/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor bzhi bsgom/ de nas rlung gis g.yos te 'ur 'ur tsheg tsheg sgra dang bcas pas/ snying padma kha thur du bub pa de/ gyen la phye ste sems kyi rgyal po hūṃ du gnas pa de/ teg teg 'dug par bsgom/ de nas/ rang gi sems kyi rgyal po lte ba'i 'og nas ar 'dug pa de/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod pas/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig gis steng du drangs la/ spyi bo'i kṣ+yum̐ de zo ba zhabs rdol ba bzhin du ha re bsgoms la/ hikka zhes brjod pas ba thag gi rnam pa lta bu de gcad nas/ yi dam lha'i thugs kar rgyangs kyis 'phos par bsgom/ de nas/ rang lha'i rnam par gsal bar bsgom/ de

de la ma 'phos na nyi shu rtsa gsum pa dang rtsa bzhi pa dang*/ rtsa lngas kyang 'pho bar bya'o// des na nges par 'pho ba'o// ni sbyangs te 'pho ba'o// btsan thabs su 'pho ba ni/ sbyangs te 'pho ba byed mi khom pa'i gnad/ klad pa lug pa lta bu'am/ rgyu ma chad pa lta bu'i nad kyis thebs na btsan thabs su 'pho bas/ ye shes btsan thabs su 'pho ba la gnyis las/ dang po stan bde bar lus tsog pur 'dug nas/ ol mdud lan gsum g.yon du gcus/ drang por bzhag la/ rba rlabs dal bus btsir/ mig zim me har re byas la mig 'bras mi 'gul/ rang (19na)gi smin mtshams su thig le dkar la 'tsher ba/ snum la 'dril ba sran rdog tsam dkar hril hril 'dug par bsgom/ de ni ye shes btsan thabs su 'pho ba yin gsung ngo*// gnyis pa lus tsog pur 'dug nas/ sems kyis yi dam lha dang*/ bla ma mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs la/ de nas ol mdud lan gsum drag par gcus la drang por bzhag la/ mthe bong gnyis kyis ol mdud pa ltag pa'i phyogs/ bdud sgo'i ngos su drag par phul nas/ de nas spyi bo zo ba zhabs phyung ba bzhin du har re 'dug par bsgom/ rang gi snying ga thur du lta ba de gyen la kha phye bar bsgom/ de'i dkyil na/ sems kyi rgyal po hūṃ du gnas pa de/ hikka ces lan nyi shu rtsa gcig drag tu brjod pas/ hūm̐ de tshangs pa'i bu ga na yar rgyangs kyis song bas/ ba thag gi skud pa lta bu de chad nas/ yi dam lha'i thugs kar song bar bsam/ de nas rang lha'i rnam par gsal bar bsgom/ des ye shes skye'o// des ni btsan thabs su 'pho ba'i thabs bshad pa yin gsung ngo*// lus bcos te 'pho ba ni/ sbyangs te 'pho ba byed pa ma khom zhing*/ btsan thabs su 'pho bar ma nus na/ lus bcos te 'pho ba la thun mong du bstan pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin par bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sku yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus su/

seng ge'i nyal stabs mdzad nas 'das te/ sems can rnams 'di ltar byas na ngan song du mi 'gro bas/ 'di ltar gyis shig par brda'i sgo nas chos 'chad pa yin pas/ tha mal pa'i sems can rnams 'chi ba'i dus su/ glo g.yas pa phab la/ mgo byang*/ (19ba)kha nub/ rgyab shar du bstan la rkang pa brkyang ste bag tsam bskum/ long bu gnyis brtsegs/ lag pa g.yas pa 'gram pa g.yas la sbyar/ lag pa g.yon pa brla g.yon pa'i steng na mar brkyang ste shi na ngan song du mi 'gro ba yin gsung*/ gnyis pa ni/ stan bde ba la 'dug ste/ gong du bstan pa ltar lus bcos la/ sems kyis yi dam dang bla ma mdun du spyan drangs te/ de nas/ rang gi lte 'og sor bzhi na/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i sum mdo ru/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gcig bsgom/ de'i steng du sems kyi rgyal po a gcig bsgom/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig pad 'dab nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgom/ de nas/ nyi ma'i 'od dmar na ra ra 'byung bas/ tshangs pa'i bu ga sgo phye ste/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig drag tu brjod pas/ sgal tshigs pad 'dab nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i steng du a de thon par bsam/ de nas/ hikka nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa brjod pas/ ba thag lta bu'i srung ba de bcad nas/ sems kyi rten nyi ma dang ar gnas pa de yi dam lha'i thugs kar 'pho bar bsam/ de nas rang lha'i rnam par gsal bar bsgom/ de la ma 'phos na/ sngar bzhin lte 'og gi nyi ma'i steng du a dang sgal tshigs pad 'dab nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgom/ hika gis pad 'dab nyi shu rtsa gcig gi steng du drangs/ de nas hikka nyi shu rtsa gnyis brjod pas/ tshangs pa'i bu gar thon te phar then tshur then yang bsgom/ de nas nyi ma dang*/ ar bcas pa'i yi dam lha'i thugs kar 'pho ba'o// de la ma 'phos na/ yang de bzhin du bskyar bas the tshom med par 'pho'o// des ni lus bcos te 'pho ba bshad do// de ltar sbyangs te 'pho ba/ btsan thabs su 'pho ba/

lus (20na)bcos te 'pho ba dang gsum gyis 'pho ba bshad pa yin no// de ltar bar do nyams su blang ba la bar do de rnam pa gsum du/ bsre ba dang 'pho ba'i man ngag gnyis su byas pas/ bar do nyams su blangs ba bshad pa yin/ de'i mthun rkyen tshogs par bya ba'i don du/ gur le'u bco lnga pa nas bshad pa'i spyod pa ci nus spyod/ des ni/ bla ma rnams kyi zhal gyi gdams pa bshad pa'o/// /bka' bzhi babs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// sprul skur grags pa'i tai lo pa// lung bstan thob pa'i nā ro pas// bcu gnyis dka' spyad mthar 'di gnang*// blo gros shes bya mar pa yis// gser gyis mnyes byas mthar 'di gnang*// chos rdor zhes bya rngog gis ni// spong thag lan gsum byas pas gnang*// bla ma gzhung pa jo sras kyis// bla ma mi la de yis bdag /chos rje zla 'od gzhon nu la// thugs la btags nas gnang ba lags// de lta'i zhal gyi gdams pa 'di// yul dang dus kyis bskal nas ni// brjed kyis dogs pa'i 'jigs pa yis// rang gi dran pa bso phyir ni// shin tu gsal bar yi ger bkod// de la 'gal ba ci mchis pa// dgyes rdor mkha' 'gror bcas pa dang*// bla ma rnams la bzod par gsol// bla ma rnams kyi zhal gdams 'di// snod dang ldan pa bsgom nges pa// re re tsam la sbyin par bya// snod dang mi ldan gang zag la// rdzas la bltas nas mang spel na// gnas zhing las skyes mkha' 'gro dang*// 'du ba'i so pas snying phyung zhig /'dzam gling bkra shis rgyal mtshan tshugs par shog/ ༈ //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag (20ba)'tshal lo// spyi bo bde ba chen po'i 'khor lo na/ rtsa 'dab ma sum cu rtsa gnyis yod/ yi ge ham̐ mgo thur du bstan pa las byang sems thig le khang yong ba/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo la/ rtsa 'dab ma bcu drug yod/ yi ge oṃ gnas/ snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo na rtsa 'dab ma brgyad yod/ yi ge hūṃ gnas/

lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la/ rtsa 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi yod/ yi ge āḥdamar po gnas/ de lte ba nas mar sor bzhi gzhal ba na/ gru gsum dhū ti'i nang na yod/ de'i a dmar po spu shad lta bu yod/ de la ro rkyang gnyis kyi sna zug yod/ de la/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi rlung mnan pas/ sbud pas lcags bzhu ba ltar/ me dmar ltem ltem je ring je ring song bas/ me des/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo bsregs pas/ rtsa sbubs kyi yi ge bsregs/ yar song snying ka chos kyi 'khor lo bsregs/ de na yar song*/ mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo bsregs/ de nas yar song*/ spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo bsregs/ ham̐ bsregs/ ham̐ gi 'od kyis spyi bo'i 'khor lo bsos/ ham̐ las 'od thigs pa/ rtsa sbubs nas babs pas/ mgrin pa'i 'khor lo'i yi ge bsos/ de nas mar babs pas/ snying ka'i 'khor lo'i yi ge bsos/ de nas/ mar babs pas/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo bsos/ lte ba nas sor bzhi'i gru gsum thab lta bu'i nang gi a dmar po spu shad lta bu las me 'bar bas/ sbubs mnan pa ltar/ me je ring je ring song*/ dhū ti'i nang na yar 'bar bas/ byang sems ham̐ la reg reg song bas/ byang sems thig le khang yod pa thigs pas/ dhū ti'i nang na (21na)mar song bas/ rtsa gru gsum nang gi spu shad lta bu'i a dmar po la phog pas/ stong par lam lam song bar bsam/ a'i me ham̐ la 'bar/ ham̐ gi thigs pa a spu shad lta bu la babs/ 'khor lo bzhi'i bsam gtan/ a thung gi 'bab bsreg ces bya ba'o// rtsa rlung gi man ngag mthar thug pa'o// phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig /maṅga laṃ wantu/ shubhaṃ// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gtum mo dang*/ ḍoṃ bhi pa'i gtum mo rnams bzhugs so// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams ngag 'di yi lugs kyi gtum mo zhes kyang bya/

drod btsan thabs su dbab pa zhes kyang bya/ lus kyi rtsa la rlung zug dbyung ba zhes kyang bya/ de la dgos pa ni/ la phrag tu 'khyags rlung rtsa sbugs su 'gags pa/ 'khyil ba/ rlung gzer ba sogs la phan/ na de la phan/ gtum mo sgom 'phro la gnyid du song nas sod tsa na 'khyags pa de la phan/ rlung smad du 'khyil nas dri chen dri chu bsdams na de la phan/ rlung bsre rlung sbud skrug pa'o// dang po lus skyil krung*/ lag pa gnyis pus mo la brlan/ mig lta stangs hur hur byas la mdun du blta/ sems lhug par bzhag /de nas/ steng 'og gi rlung drag por thub tshad bsdams/ ma thub pa'i dus lan drag po gsum du gcun nas btang*/ de bzhin du g.yas su yang bya'o// de la lan gsum du bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ lus skyil krung bya/ lag pa thal mo sbyar la/ mthe'u chung sprad la/ lhag ma rnams bskums nas pus mo khar bzhag la rlung bsdam/ ma bcas la re/ (21ba)mdun drang po na phar shad shad drag por 'phang ba lan gsum/ de nas g.yas drang por lan gsum/ g.yon drang por lan gsum bya gsung*/ thub pa dang phyag rgya de snying ga /mgrin pa/ dpral bar khyer la/ yas mar rim pa bzhin du de ltar lan gsum gsum bya'o// gsum pa ni/ rkang pa g.yas brkyang*/ g.yon bskum pa la/ phyag rgya snga ma pus mo'i khar bzhag /rlung thub tshad bsdam/ ma thub pa'i dus su/ phyag dang po lag pa g.yas pa shad shad lan gsum/ de nas g.yon pa yang de bzhin bya'o// de nas rkang pa g.yas pa shad shad lan gsum/ de nas rkang pa g.yon pa yang de bzhin du bya'o// rgya de g.yas su khyer la/ g.yas su lan gsum drag tu gcu'o// rkang pa g.yas brkyang*/ g.yon bskum ste snga ma bzhin no// de tsho rje btsun mi la ras pa'i phyag bzhes yin no// ༈ //bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gtum mo'i gdam ngag la gnyis te/ lo rgyus dang dgos ched do// lo rgyus ni/ bcom ldan 'das he ru kas/ yum bdag med ma la gnang*/

des bla ma tai lo pa la gnang*/ des bla ma nā ro pa la gnang*/ des slob dpon ḍoṃ bhi pa la gnang ba'o// dgos ched la/ rang gzhung dang*/ log gnon gnyis las/ rang gzhung la/ lus kyi gnad dang*/ sems kyi gnad gnyis/ lus kyi gnad la/ rkang pa bre phul ltar brtsegs/ lag pa mgal me ltar bsnol ba/ sgal tshigs mda' smyug ltar bsrang ba/ rgya mtsho ri rab la sbyar ba/ mgrin pa rma bya ltar dgug pa/ chu mig gyen la log pa/ ba dan mkha' la 'phyar ba'o// sems kyi gnad/ (22na)la/ ngar gdong 'og tu lcags kyi 'brub khung bsgom/ de'i nang du/ ram̐ las me sbar/ lte ba'i 'og tu yi ge a shad kyi rnam pa lta bu sor gcig pa zhig bsgom/ de las me sbar bas/ khong pa mes khengs par bsgom/ me lce ba spu'i bu ga na mar song bas/ lus la me'i bu gu ris su bskor bar bsgom/ du ba nam mkha'i mthong du song bar bsgom/ 'khyags na lus la 'khor bar bsgom/ log gnon la/ khrag log na/ gzhu ltar bkug la mda' ltar 'phang ngo*// rlung stod du log na/ hed kyis mnan/ smad du log na/ hig gis 'don/ drod log na/ rdul phyis la grangs su bcug la bsgom/ srin log na 'og sgo glod la rdo rje rgyun khrus bya/ 'gro na/ rtsa chen bzhi srog pa rtsa dbu mar skyon/ nyal na tshig bzhi bcings pa'i gnad byas la nyal lo/// / ༈ na mo gu ru/ bla ma rin po che nā ro pa'i gdams pa yi/ chos bcu drug bsdu na/ las kyi gtum mo/ 'bar ba'i gtum mo/ phyag rgya chen po'i gtum mo'o// las kyi gtum mo ni/ gsang gnas na a shad lta bu gcig gnas te/ ma bsgoms na a dmar po gnas/ bsgoms na me tshon gang ba/ mas yar 'bar bas/ bag chags dang gdon thams cad bsreg go /saṃ bu ṭi las/ lha yi rnal 'byor dus su ni// skra yi rtse mo'i khyon tsam de// 'od zer glog stong 'khyug pa bzhin// ba spu'i bu ga'i tshang nas ni// phyung ste phyogs bcur gnas pa yis// lha dang lha min sdig par mdzad// ces gsungs so// las kyi gtum mo'o// 'bar ba'i gtum mo ni/

lus kyi gnad yul (22ba)lnga dang 'dra ste/ lus mda' ltar bsrang ba la byed bcings lnga'o// rtsa'i gnad lam dang 'dra ste/ g.yas la la nā thabs kyi rtsa/ g.yon ra sa na shes rab kyi rtsa/ dbus ma a wa dhū ti chos nyid kyi rtsa'o// rlung gi gnad rta dang 'dra ste/ g.yas pa gzung ba'i rlung rgyu/ g.yon pa 'dzin pa'i rlung rgyu/ dbus ma chos nyid kyi rlung rgyu'o// de yang*/ lus yul dang 'dra bas/ lus gang na gnas pa na rtsa gnas/ rtsa lam dang 'dra/ rtsa gang na gnas pa na rlung gnas/ rlung rta dang 'dra/ rlung gang na gnas pa na rig pa gnas/ rig rta'i steng du mi zhon nas kha lo bsgyur ba bzhin du/ rta la mi zha bo gcig gzhon nas/ rtas rkang pa byas mis mig byas pas/ gang 'dod pa'i sar phyin bzhin du/ pa mi dang 'dra/ rig pa gang na gnas pa na nor dang 'dra ba'i stong pa gnas/ stong pa gang na gnas pa na bde ba chen po gter dang 'dra bar gnas/ des gsang bar me la gtad pas dgos 'dod 'byung*/ zhes gsungs pas/ dper na me rtags du ba lta bu ste/ rtsa las su rung ba'i rtags tshad/ lus yod du mi tshor/ zo mdog bde/ bdag sha bkrag gting nas 'bar ba/ 'gro ba thams cad dbang du 'dus pa gsum/ rlung las su rung ba'i rtags/ btsan dang yang dang mgyogs pa dang*// dbugs dang rngam pa mi 'gyur dang*// ji tsam 'gog kyang nad med dang*// steng dang 'og dang g.yas g.yon sogs// sems kyi gang 'dod spo nus pa'o// drod la dbang*/ dhū tir tshud nas/ rnam rtog rang 'gags su song nas ye shes ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin 'char te/ zad par rlung la sogs pa dang*/ tshe'i dbang du mi byed do// de la drod skye ste/ lus phyi la drod skyes pas rngul ba dang*/ (23na)drod skye ba dang*/ tshig pa mi za'o// lus nang la drod skyes pas/ mdangs gsal ba/ srin bu phyir thon pa'o// phyi nang med par drod skyes pas/ phyi nyams nang du 'char/ nang nyams phyir 'char ro// drod rtags ma byung bar du brtson 'grus drag po bskyed cing bsgom mo// de tshad du phyin nas phyag rgya chen po'i gtum mo ni/

dbang po'i sgo mi dgag /nyi ma dang zla ba brtson du bzung la/ me yid la mi byed/ rtsa gsum yid la mi byed/ rlung mi bsdam/ de yang gzhan la ma ltos pa bzhi 'byung*/ lta ba gzhan la ma ltos pa'i sems gsal ba me long lta bu khong nas 'char/ stong pa gzhan la mi ltos pa'i dbu ma'i chos dbyings khong nas 'char/ bde ba gzhan la ma ltos pa'i phyag rgya chen po'i de kho na nyid khong nas 'char/ zung 'jug 'od gsal rdzogs pa'i don khong nas 'char te/ de nyid sgom pa de mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob spyod lam thams cad du khyer bar bya'o// spyod lam dang ni ma bral na/ rmi lam du yang gtan la dbab/ de nyid la khyad med na/ rmi lam ci 'dra ba der shes so// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa ni/ dang po gsum bsgoms pas/ rtags dang drod mi skye mi srid/ de nas rnam rtog mi 'gag mi srid/ de nas ye shes mi skye mi srid/ de nas sangs mi rgya mi srid do// bla ma'i gtum mo rnam gsum mo// ༈ // zhabs rjes gsang spyod ma zhes bya ba'o// bla ma rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po byang chub kyi sems gsum/ rang skad cig gis lhar bsam la/ mdun du zhabs rjes bkram la/ de la dmigs nas/ shūn+ya ta'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas stong par bsam/ (23ba)stong pa'i ngang las zhabs rjes de bla mar bsam/ bla ma'i thugs kar rang gi yi dam gyi gdan sa bon bsam/ sa bon las 'od zer 'phros lus khyab/ sdig pa dang sha khrag sbyangs nas/ bla ma yi dam lhar bsam/ de nas/ yi dam lha'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad la phog /sha khrag dang sdig sgrib sbyangs/ thams cad yi dam lhar gyur/ tshur 'dus thugs kar thim/ yang 'od zer gnyis 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la zhabs rjes la bstim/ yang 'od zer 'phros pas/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad spyan drangs la bstims la/

yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa dbul/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang dpa' mo thams cad dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba la ting nge 'dzin phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ shes rab phun sum tshogs pa dang*/ rtogs pa phun sum tshogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bstan pa'i rim pa mtha' dag rgyud la skye ba dang*/ de'i mi mthun phyogs mtha' dag nub par byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de nas dge ba bsngo/ smon lam gdab/ yang bla ma dang yi dam la 'phrig gam sel yod na/ sems gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ rang skad cig gis yi dam lhar bsam/ zhabs rjes bkram la/ 'od zer spro bsdu la sogs pa yan chad sngar dang mthun/ de nas rten de la dmigs nas/ (24na)dam tshig nyams pa bshags pa'i bsam pas/ yi ge brgya pa bzlas pa zin pa dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ bdag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad sor chud par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ dam tshig la sems 'phrig yod na/ bla ma zhal bzhugs na dngos su bshags/ mi bzhugs na sku 'bag la bshags/ glang po che ko ba can gyi gtam rgyud yod/ yang na bla ma gzhan gcig la chos sku gcig pa yin pa'i bsam pas bshags kyang btub/ dngos po a thang chad pa med// bshags par bya dang bshags pa rnams// gang tshe sbyor ba ma mthong ba// rang bzhin dag pas yang dag mthong*// de ni bshags pa'i mchog yin no// zhes gsungs/ sgyu ma'i blo yod na bshags pa la tshegs med gsung*/ yang bla ma zhal bzhugs tsa na man ngag dang*/ chos bshad pa la sogs pa'i lung med nas/ bla ma mi bzhugs pa'i dus su lung blang ba ni/ sems gsum gyis blang steng*/ rang yi dam du bsam la/ sngar bzhin yan lag bdun pa yan chad rgyas par byas la/

bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis/ bdag la 'di dang 'di'i lung gnang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ gang 'dod pa'i lung bstan par bsam/ rten de bla ma'i ngo bor byas la/ mi gshegs par ngo bor bzhag /zin pa dang (24ba)dge rtsa bsngo/ smon lam gdab/ 'chal ba dang 'grogs pa'i nyes pa 'dis mi thub/ sme brtsegs rang dgos gsung*/ zhabs rjes la rab gnas yod na legs/ med kyang btub gsung*/ zhabs rjes 'di gsang spyod yin pas/ gzhan la mi bstan gsung ngo*// zhabs rjes la brten pa'i gdams pa'o// maṅga laṃ wantu// ༈ //

chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ bar do gzhi bzhig gdams pa'o// na mo ratna gu ru/ skyes ni skyes/ shi ni ma shi ba de/ skye shi'i bar do'o// gnyid log ni log /sad ni ma sad pa de rmi lam bar do'o// lus 'di ni bor/ phyi ma ni ma blangs pa de/ srid pa bar do yin no// gang mngon du byed na/ 'od gsal mngon du byed/ gsal stong la zer ro// 'od gsal mngon du byed pa la/ gsal stong bsgom pa gal che ba yin/ gang mngon du byed na/ rmi lam mngon du byed/ rmi lam gang mngon du byed na/ 'od gsal mngon du byed do// bla ma dam pa'i man ngag gis mtshams sbyar ba'o// mtshams dran pa dang 'dun pas sbyar/ rmi lam zhig rmi bar bya'o snyam pa de la bya'o// mtshams thabs shes gnyis kyis sbyar bar bya'o// bsre ba rtsa rlung gis 'dod chags dang bsre ba'o// bsre ba gti mug gis gnyid dang bsre ba'o// bsre ba 'od gsal gyis zhe sdang dang bsre ba'o// lus rnam par smin pa'i lus yin no// lus bag chags kyi lus yin no// lus yid kyi lus yin no// maṅga laṃ wantu// ༈ // chos rje dwags po lha rje'i gsung*/ 'pho ba'i gdams pa bzhugs so// yon tan kun dang ldan pa yi// bla ma dam pa rnams dang ni// rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal nas// (25na)'pho ba'i sbyor ba bdag gis bri// de la gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ bskyed rim la brten nas/ rdzogs rim la rtags 'ga' zung thon nas kyang*/ lus rgas te mchog ma thob par 'chi ba'am/ yang na bskyed rim bsgom 'phro la 'chi rtags byung nas/ sgrub pa'i long med dus su 'pho ba bya ba ni/ dgyes pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gur gyi le'u bco lnga pa'i rdo rje slob dpon sku 'gyur pa'i skabs dang*/ de'i rgyas par bshad pa saṃ bu ṭi dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi dang*/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa nas bshad pa ni/

sbyangs te 'pho ba'i mchog thob pa 'di mchog yin te/ 'di la 'bad pas 'pho bar bya'o// de'i rim pa yang*/ dang po 'chi blu shes pa'i gang zag gis/ phyi nang gi 'chi ltas brtags te 'chi bar shes nas/ 'pho ba la bslab cing sbyangs pas/ 'chi khar tshegs med par 'pho ba yin te/ de la bslab cing sbyang ba'i rim pa ni/ saṃ bu ṭi dang*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi la sogs pa nas/ 'pho ba'i sgo rab 'bring tha ma gsum bshad de/ de gang zhe na/ lte ba 'dod khams mtho ris te// thig le'i gzugs kyi lus can no// gong mas gong ma'i gnas su ni// 'gro ba de ni yongs su brtags// sna nas gnod sbyin gnas su ste// rna ba gnyis nas grub pa'i lha// gal te mig nas ye shes 'gro// mi rnams kyi ni rgyal por 'gro// srid pa'i sgo yis yi dwags rnams// de bzhin chu ris dud 'gror gnas// chu min rnam shes myur du 'gro /dmyal ba brgyad kyi dngos po rnams// gang gi sgo yi bye brag gis// 'khor ba las ni rgal bar 'gyur// des na sgo yi bye brag gis// (25ba)rnal 'byor pa yi lam bzang po// 'chi 'pho'i mtshan ma byung ba yis// 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i dus byung na// rims la sogs pas ma phog par// 'pho ba'i sbyor ba mchog yin no// dbugs rngub sngon du brtsams nas ni// thams cad sgo ni dgag par bya// zhes gsungs/ de'i don rim pa bzhin du bshad na/ 'chi ba'i dus su lte ba nas 'phos na 'dod khams kyi lhar skye/ smin par gyi thig le nas 'phos na/ gzugs khams kyi lhar skye/ spyi gtsug sdud pa nas/ gzugs med skye ba don du gnyer mi byed// ces gsungs pa/ 'dir ma skyes pa rung*/ zhes gsungs/ nas 'phos na/ gzugs med kyi lhar skye'o// de gsum ni sgo rab gsum mo// sna nas 'phos na gnod sbyin/ rna ba gnyis nas 'phos na/ rig 'dzin gyi lha/ mig gnyis nas 'phos na/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por skye ste/

de gsum ni sgo 'bring gsum mo// kha nas 'phos na yi dwags/ chu lam nas 'phos na dud 'gro/ bshang lam nas nges par dmyal bar skye ste/ de gsum ni sgo tha ma gsum mo// de ltar sgo rab 'bring tha ma gsum gyi skyon yon shes par byas la/ dang po rlung la sbyang ba ni/ 'byung 'jug gnyis gcig tu bgrangs pa'i sum cu so drug tha ma'o// bdun cu rtsa gnyis 'bring*/ brgya rtsa brgyad thub na rab kyi tshad yin/ de nas rlung de ltar sbyangs pa dang*/ de nas/ rang khams bde ba la 'chi ltas brtag ste/ phyi nang gi 'chi ltas byung nas/ 'chi ba slu ba'i cho ga bya/ des kyang mi thub pa 'dra na/ 'pho ba'i man ngag la 'jug par bya ste/ de la sbyor dngos gnyis las/ sbyor ba ni/ rang yi dam lhar bsgoms te/ lus (26na)bde bar gnas pas dbang po'i sgo dgu dgag pa ni/ spyi bo tshangs bug tu kṣa/ mig gnyis su hūm̐ re re sngon po/ rna ba gnyis su yum̐ re re sngon po/ sna gnyis su mu re re sngon po/ lce la sum̐ dkar po/ smin bar du hūṃ/ sngon po/ dri chen kṣa yum du klog pa'o// dri chu'i bar du kṣ+yum̐ re re/ lte bar sngon po/ hūm̐/ snying gar nang gi lte ba'i dbus na gnas pa'i/ hūṃ sngon po rnams kyis bkag la/ dngos po thams cad sgyu ma lta bur/ mos pa bya ste/ rang lus sngar ltar lhar gsal ba'i lus 'khrul 'khor bca' ba'o// de nas steng rlung drangs la/ shes pa lte ba'i a la gtad/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig ni/ pad ma 'dab ma nyi shu rtsa gcig tu bsgom/ rlung dang bcas pas hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig gis/ lte ba'i aḥde/ pad 'dab re re la yar yar spyi bor bde ba chen por drangs te/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis su byas na/ shes pa 'chor bas mi bya'o// de nas yang*/ nyi shu rtsa gcig gis ka hig ces brjod cing mar drang ngo*// de ltar nyi ma re re'am/ thun bzhir yar sbyong mar sbyong byed pa ni/ dper na/ rta rgyug byed na/

sngon la yar 'gro mar 'gro byed cing*/ rta la dkyus sa ston pa ltar/ rlung sems sngon nas yar sbyong mar sbyong byed pa ni/ dang por sbyang ba'o// de nas 'chi nges te rtags rdzogs par gyur nas/ 'pho ba dngos gzhi bya ba ni/ 'byor ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams tshogs gsog btang*/ 'khor gyi mya ngan dang ngu 'bod/ smre sngags rnams snga nas spangs te/ mtshams byas la/ bar do nas sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'gro snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po sngon du btang la/ 'chi dus su gnas khang chag chag btab/ ras ris la (26ba)sogs pa'i rten dgram/ mchod pa dang*/ tshogs kyi yo byad rnams bshams la/ rang lhar bsgom ste/ yi dam gyi lha tshogs rnams spyan drangs la/ mchod pa dang tshogs phul la/ rlung ro lan gsum phyung*/ gong pa bzhin dbang po'i sgo rnams bkag /khyad par du mchan khung gnyis su rlung gi sa bon yam̐ re re bsgom/ dku gnyis su oṃ re re/ rkang mthil gnyis su yam̐ re re bsgom/ snying ga'i hūm̐ la yam̐ bzhis bskor bar bya/ dngos po thams cad la sgyu ma'i blo bskyed nas/ mi dga' ba med par dga' spro dang bcas pas/ shes pa yi dam lha'i thugs kar 'phang ngo snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po bya la/ mdun gyi nam mkhar yi dam gyi lha spyan drangs la de dag gsal bar bsgom/ tshangs bug gi kṣa phyung nas/ spyi bo'i sgo har gyis phye ste steng rlung mnan/ 'og rlung drangs la/ lte ba sprul pa nas/ spyi gtsug bde chen man chad du/ sgal tshigs nyi shu rtsa gcig 'od zer du bsdus nas gnas par bsgom/ shes pa lte ba'i aḥl gtad pas/ hikka zhes lan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis drag tu drangs la/ lte ba sprul pa nas spyi gtsug bde chen man chad du/ hi ka re res/ pad 'dab re re la/ aḥthung ngu re re drangs te/ lte ba'i aḥdang*/ snying ka'i hūm̐ gnyis 'dres nas yar yar drangs te/ hūm̐ de nyid tha ma spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu gar yer te byung ba dang*/

hikka nyi shu rtsa gcig song ba'i rting ma/ nyi shu rtsa gnyis pa la/ hūm̐ gi 'od zer gyi thag pa bcad nas/ tshangs bug nas yar sems nyid yi ge ar gnas pa de thal gyis song nas/ yi dam lha'i thugs kar btang ste/ 'phos nas lus 'di dor bar bya'o// de yang cis shes na/ rdo rje gur gyi le'u (27na)bco lnga pa'i zhabs/ rdo rje slob dpon 'da' ba'i skabs nas ston la/ de nyid rgyas par ni/ saṃ bu ṭi dang*/ gdan bzhi la sogs pa nas bstan no// des na/ phyi nang gnyis ka'i 'chi rtags gtan la phebs nas/ 'chi nges pa'i dus 'pho ba'o// de ltar shes na/ mtshams med kyis las byas pa yang*/ nges par 'pho'o// de ltar shes na/ mtshams med lnga byas pa yang*/ nges par mya ngan las 'das pa'i sar 'gro bar rgyud las gsungs so// 'chi ba'i dus su yi dam lan cig mi 'ong mi srid pas/ de'i thugs kar shes pa 'pho'o// de lta bu sbyangs te 'pho ba zhes bya ba/ nā ro pa chen po'i gdams pa/ bla ma lho brag pas dngos su 'pho ba mdzad/ bla ma mi la chen pos kyang dngos su 'pho ba mdzad pa'i gdams ngag thun mong ma yin pa'o// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis 'pho ba ni/ lus drang por bsrang ma nus na/ seng ge'i nyal stabs kyis 'pho ste/ dbang po'i sgo dgag pa dang*/ 'pho thabs 'gre'o// btsan thabs su 'pho ba ni/ ye shes skye ba'i thabs btsal te/ skye ba dang*/ tsitta dang*/ kyi nya na bskyed/ bha su ka ra drangs la/ tsam po ka lan gsum bskor ro// ༈ //na mo gu ru/ gang du 'pho ba'i man ngag la/ 'chi ltas brtags la/ zhes pa'i don gyi 'chi ltas brtags pa ni/ dang po rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid kyis tshe'i phyag rgya bcings te/ ā yu de wa sa ra ha ka re sha hūm̐ phaṭaḥ dus ni rnam pa bzhi dag tu// tshe yi grib ma 'ong gyur te// srog gi brla gnas rab brtag zhing*// sa yi dmigs ni (27ba)rgyun mi bcad/ tshe yi mgo bo chad gyur na// de tshe zla ba gcig na 'chi// tshe gzugs zlum por gyur pa na// de tshe zla ba gnyis na 'chi// tshe gzugs spyi bor tshugs gyur na// de tshe zla ba bzhi na 'chi// tshe gzugs yan lag ma tshang na// gtor ma bzhi yis phyogs bzhir mchod// tshe gzugs dmar por gyur pa'i tshe// nad dang rma ngo yod pas na// 'jig rten gtor mas bzlog par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa de nyid rgyas par bshad na/

nam mkha' sprin med pa'i dus su/ mi med pa'i dgon par phyin la/ der maṇḍal byas la yi dam la mchod bstod byas te/ de nas tshe'i phyag rgya bzhi bya ba ni/ nyi ma shar thog dang*/ nyi ma nub la khad pa'i dus dang*/ zla ba shar ma thog dang*/ nub la khad pa'i dus te/ de bzhi gang rung gcig la blta ba ni/ skra spyi bor bcings/ lus gcer bur phyung ste/ lag pa gnyis brkyang*/ rkang pa gnyis bshibs te/ langs nas/ rang gi grib ma'i snying kar mig mi 'dzum par blta ste/ de la yun ring bar bltas la/ mig 'gribs pa dang*/ 'thibs pa byung na/ mig nam mkha' phye rung gis ngang nas/ la bltas pas/ nam mkha' la gzugs 'ong ba brtag go /de la ma mthong na/ lus rdo rje skyil krung*/ lag pa mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya byas la brtag go /de la gzugs ci yang ma byung na skyon du mi blta ste/ nam mkha' sprin dang*/ se ru'i zhad byung ba yin pas/ mi 'gal lo// de la gong du bstan pa'i lugs ltar zla ba bzhi 'chi ba'i ltas la phyi nang gsang gsum mo// lta bu'i 'chi ltas byung na/ 'chi blu zla ba gcig bya ste/ yang sngar bzhin bltas pas/ yan lag nang gi byung na rlung sgom pa/ gsang (28na)ba ni don med par byang sems 'bab pa ma chod na 'chi/ de bcad pa ni/ byang sems sna bug g.yon par zhugs la bsgom mo// thams cad rdzogs na mchi ba blus so// de'i dus su/ tshe gzugs zlum por gyur nas/ zla ba gcig nas 'chi ba blu ba'i dge sbyor bya'o// de nas yang*/ zla ba gcig lon nas bltas pas/ spyi'u tshugs su gyur par mthong na/ zla ba gcig nas 'chi nges te/ tshe'i rnam smin zad pa yin pas/ dge sbyor la zhugs te mi dga' ba med par/ dngos po thams cad sgyu ma yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag po bya'o// de nas yang sngar ltar zhag grangs ma nor bar 'chi ba'i nyin mo'i dus der gnas thams cad chag chag btab ste/ thang ka la sogs pa yang bres la/ rang yi dam gyi lhar bskyed pa ni lus kyi 'khrul 'khor

de nas lha dang snang ba thams cad/ skye med 'od gsal gyi mos pa byas pas/ tha mal gyi zhen pa bzlog ste/ sems kyi 'khrul 'khor bcas pa'o// bca' ba'o// de nas 'pho ni lugs gnyis te/ rang gi shes pa bde ba can gyi zhing khams su 'pho ba'am/ yang na/ rang gi shes pa snying kar hūm̐ la lhan gyis bsdus te/ man ngag bzhin yi dam mdun du spyan drangs la/ de'i thugs kar rang gi shes pa de rgyangs kyis btang ngo*// oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum bzlas pa ni ngag gi 'khrul 'khor bca' ba'o// de dus su lag pa gnyis ltag par sbrel/ pus mo gnyis tsog pur bshibs/ rgyab dbyug pa la brten/ snying gyen la log gis btang la/ kha nas snying ka'i hūm̐ de rgyangs kyis thon nas yi dam gyi thugs ka'am/ bde ba can du btang ste/ hikka ces pas yun ring por yang dag par drangs te/ dbugs nang du ma btang bas nges par (28ba)'pho'o// sangs rgyas kyi bka' nas/ kha nas 'phos na/ yi dwags gnas su 'gro bar bshad de/ de ni 'pho ba'i man ngag mi shes par tha mal du 'chi ba la dgongs pa'o// 'dir ni yi dam lha mdun du byas te nges par bde ba can du skye'o// nang gi 'chi ltas byung nas 'pho bar bya'o// 'chi khar yi dam lha mi 'byon mi srid de/ rdo rje gur las/ slob dpon gyi ni thar dus su// 'chi ba 'jig rten mi gnas pas// skye bo 'jig rten rmongs pa gang*// de 'dir shi zhes smra bar byed// 'chi ba zhes pa'i rnam rtog gis// dag pa'i gnas su 'khyer bar byed// yang na bde ba can du nges// 'dod pa'i rigs su skye bar 'gyur// me tog sna tshogs lags thogs shing*// rgyal mtshan byug pa glu sogs kyis// lus las lus gzhan 'gro bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// tsakra saṃ bha ra nas kyang bshad do// nā ro chen po'i gdams ngag /sangs rgyas mngon sum du 'byung ba'o/// /bla ma grub thob rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bar do 'chi ka ma'i man ngag bri/
